name: Prayer after waking up for tahajjud prayer
content: Say 10 times -
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar
translation: Allah is the greatest.

name: Dua of Istikhara
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيْرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوْبِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ (وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ) خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِيْنِيْ وَمَعَاشِيْ وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِيْ، فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ. [اَللَّهُمَّ] وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِيْنِيْ وَمَعَاشِيْ وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِيْ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِيْ بِهِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْتَخِيْرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَاَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَاَسْاَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ فَاِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا اَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا اَعْلَمُ وَاَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوْبِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ اَنَّ هَذٰا الْاَمْرَ (وَيُسَمِّيْ حَاجَتَهٗ) خَيْرٌ لِيْ فِيْ دِيْنِيْ وَمَعَاشِيْ وَعَاقِبَةِ اَمْرِيْ، فَاقْدُرْهُ لِيْ وَيَسِّرْهُ لِيْ ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِيْ فِيْهِ. [اَللّٰهُمَّ] وَاِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ اَنَّ هَذٰا الْاَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِيْ فِيْ دِيْنِيْ وَمَعَاشِيْ وَعَاقِبَةِ اَمْرِيْ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّيْ وَاصْرِفْنِيْ عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ اَرْضِنِيْ بِهٖ
clean: اللهم اني استخيرك بعلمك واستقدرك بقدرتك واسالك من فضلك العظيم فانك تقدر ولا اقدر وتعلم ولا اعلم وانت علام الغيوب اللهم ان كنت تعلم ان هذا الامر ويسمي حاجته خير لي في ديني ومعاشي وعاقبه امري فاقدره لي ويسره لي ثم بارك لي فيه اللهم وان كنت تعلم ان هذا الامر شر لي في ديني ومعاشي وعاقبه امري فاصرفه عني واصرفني عنه واقدر لي الخير حيث كان ثم ارضني به
transliteration: Allaahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika, Wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratika, Wa as'aluka min fadlika Al-'azim Fa-innaka taqdiru Wala aqdiru, Wa ta'lamu Wala a'lamu, Wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub. Allaahumma, in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra Khairun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa'aqibati `Amri, Faqdurhu li wa yas-sirhu li thumma barik li Fih, (Allaahumma) Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra shar-run li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa'aqibati `Amri Fasrifhu anni was-rifni anhu. Waqdur li al-khaira haithu kana Thumma ardini bih
translation: O Allah! I ask guidance from Your knowledge, And Power from Your Might and I ask for Your great blessings. You are capable and I am not. You know and I do not and You know the unseen. O Allah! If You know that this job is good for my religion and my subsistence and in my Hereafter. Then You ordain it for me and make it easy for me to get, And then bless me in it, and if You know that this job is harmful to me In my religion and subsistence and in the Hereafter. Then keep it away from me and let me be away from it. And ordain for me whatever is good for me, And make me satisfied with it.
note: On the authority of Jaabir Ibn 'Adbullaah (RA), he said: The Prophet (ﷺ) would instruct us to pray for guidance in all of our concerns, just as he would teach us a Soorah from the Quran. He would say: 'If any of you intends to undertake a matter then let him pray two supererogatory units [two rak'ah naafilah] of prayer and after which he should supplicate: (the above mentioned dua)

name: The prayer of repentance
content: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a servant commits a sin, then performs ablution properly, then stands up and prays two rak'ats and seeks forgiveness from Allah, Allah will surely forgive him." Then he recited this verse –
uthmani: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَن يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلُوا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ ﴿١٣٥﴾ أُولَٰئِكَ جَزَاؤُهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَجَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ ﴿١٣٦﴾
indopak: وَالَّذِينَ اِذَا فَعَلُوْا فَاحِشَةً اَوْ ظَلَمُوْا اَنْفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوْا لِذُنُوْبِهِمْ وَمَن يَّغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوْا عَلٰى مَا فَعَلُوْا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ ﴿١٣٥﴾ اُولٰئِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ وَجَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَارُ خَالِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا ۚ وَنِعْمَ اَجْرُ الْعَامِلِيْنَ ﴿١٣٦﴾
clean: والذين اذا فعلوا فاحشه او ظلموا انفسهم ذكروا الله فاستغفروا لذنوبهم ومن يغفر الذنوب الا الله ولم يصروا علي ما فعلوا وهم يعلمون ١٣٥ اولءك جزاءهم مغفره من ربهم وجنات تجري من تحتها الانهار خالدين فيها  ونعم اجر العاملين ١٣٦
translation: (135) And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins -  and who can forgive sins except Allah ? -  and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know. (136) Those -  their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens beneath which rivers flow [in Paradise], wherein they will abide eternally; and excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers. (Sura Ali Imran 3:135-136)

name: Dua for closing the eyes of the dead body
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِيْنَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهٗ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهٗ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّيْنَ، وَاخْلُفْهٗ فِيْ عَقِبِهٖ فِيْ الْغَابِرِيْنَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهٗ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِيْ قَبْرِهٖ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهٗ فِيْهِ
clean: اللهم اغفر له وارفع درجته في المهديين واخلفه في عقبه في الغابرين واغفر لنا وله يا رب العالمين وافسح له في قبره ونور له فيه
transliteration: Alla-humma'gfir lahu (person's name), warfa'a darajatahu fil mahdiyin, wa'khlufhu fi 'aqibihi fil ga-birin, wagfir lana wa lahu ya rabbal' a-lamin, wafsa'ah lahu fi qabrihi, wa nau-wir lahu fihi
translation: O Allah, forgive him (person's name), raise his degree among those who are rightly guided, grant him a successor in his descendants who remain. Forgive us and him, O Lord of the Universe, and make his grave spacious, and grant him light in it.
note: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to Abu Salama (RA) (as he died). His eyes were fixedly open. Rasoolullah (ﷺ) closed them, and then said: When the soul is taken away the sight follows it. Some of the people of his family wept and wailed. So he said: Do not supplicate for yourselves anything but good, for angels say "Amen" to what you say. He then said- (The dua is mentioned above)

name: Throwing soil after burial
content: It is narrated in Sahih Hadith that after burying the dead, it is Sunnah for those present to throw soil three times with both hands. Abu Hurairah (RA) said: "The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a janaza prayer. Then he went to the grave of the dead man and threw soil on him three times from the side of his head."

name: When placing the dead in the grave #1
content: Ibn 'Umar (RA) said, "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say this dua when he put the dead body in the grave:
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ (ﷺ)
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَعَلٰى سُنَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰه (ﷺ)
clean: بسم الله وعلي سنه رسول الله
transliteration: Bismillaahi wa 'alaa sunnati Rasulillaah
translation: With the Name of Allah and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).

name: When placing the dead in the grave #2
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, ‘When you put death body in grave, say:
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَعَلٰى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ
clean: بسم الله وعلي مله رسول الله
transliteration: Bismillaahi wa 'alaa millati Rasoolillaah
translation: With the Name of Allah and according to the millat of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
note: Sunnah is to place the dead in the grave on his right side. There is no evidence to place the dead on his back and hands on the chest. When giving soil, there is no Dua to recite except Bismillah.

name: When placing the dead in the grave #3
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, When you put death body in grave, say:
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَفِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ وَعَلٰى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ
clean: بسم الله وفي سبيل الله وعلي مله رسول الله
transliteration: Bismillahi wa fi sabilillahi wa 'ala millati rasoolillah (ﷺ)
translation: With the Name of Allah, in the path of Allah and according to the millat of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)

name: Dua for visiting graves #1
uthmani: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُسْلِمِيْنَ إِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُوْنَ أَسْاَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
indopak: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ اَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُسْلِمِيْنَ اِنَّا اِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُوْنَ اَسْاَلُ اللّٰهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
clean: السلام عليكم اهل الديار من المءمنين والمسلمين انا ان شاء الله بكم لاحقون اسال الله لنا ولكم العافيه
transliteration: As-salamu 'alaykum ahlad diyari min al-mu'minina wal-muslimin, inna In sha' Allahu bikum lahikun, as-alullaha lana walakumul 'afiyah
translation: Peace be upon you, the inhabitants of the grave, among the believers, and Muslims, and if Allah will then we shall join you. I pray to Allah peace for us and for you.
note: Buraida ibnul husaib aslami (RA) narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach them to recite this dua when anyone went to the graveyard.

name: Dua for visiting graves #2
uthmani: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقْدِمِيْنَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتَأْخِرِيْنَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَلَاحِقُونَ
indopak: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰى اَهْلِ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَيَرْحَمُ اللّٰهُ الْمُسْتَقْدِمِيْنَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتَأْخِرِيْنَ وَاِنَّا اِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ بِكُمْ لَلَاحِقُوْنَ
clean: السلام علي اهل الديار من المءمنين والمسلمين ويرحم الله المستقدمين منا والمستاخرين وانا ان شاء الله بكم للاحقون
transliteration: As-salamu 'ala ahlid diya-ri minal mu’minin wal muslimin, wa yarhamullahul mustaq’dimina minna-wal mustakhirin, wa inna- insa allahu bikum lala-’hiqun
translation: Peace be upon the inhabitants of this place among the believers and Muslims. May Allah have mercy upon those who have gone on ahead of us and those who come later on, and we will join you, if Allah wills.
note: A’isha (RA) asked Allah’s messenger (ﷺ) what she should say, i.e. when visiting graves, and he told her to say (The Dua is mentioned above).

name: Dua for visiting graves #3
uthmani: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِيْنَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُوْنَ
indopak: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِيْنَ، وَاِنَّا اِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُوْنَ
clean: السلام عليكم دار قوم مءمنين وانا ان شاء الله بكم لاحقون
transliteration: As-salamu 'alaikum dara qaumin mu’minin, wa inna-insha- allahu bikum la-‘hikun
translation: Peace be upon you, O you who believe. We will meet you, if Allah willing.
note: Abu Hurairah said, "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to the graveyard and said these words."

name: Dua for visiting graves #4
uthmani: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَأَتَاكُمْ مَا تُوعَدُونَ غَدًا مُؤَجَّلُونَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَهْلِ بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ
indopak: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَاَتَاكُمْ مَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ غَدًا مُّؤَجَّلُوْنَ وَاِنَّا اِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُوْنَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِاَهْلِ بَقِيْعِ الْغَرْقَدِ
clean: السلام عليكم دار قوم مءمنين واتاكم ما توعدون غدا مءجلون وانا ان شاء الله بكم لاحقون اللهم اغفر لاهل بقيع الغرقد
transliteration: As-salamu 'alaikum da-ra kaumin mu’minin, wa ata-kum ma-tu’aadun ‘gadan muajjalun, wa inna-insha- allahu bikum la-’hikun. Alla-humma’gfir liahli baki‘eil garqad.
translation: Peace be upon you, O you who believers inhabitants of the grave! The promise that was given to you has come to you, and you are waiting for the day to come. And we will meet you by the will of Allah. O Allah, forgive the inhabitants of the Baqi graveyard.
note: Ayesha (RA) said, "When Rasoolullah (ﷺ) stayed in my house, he used to go to the Baqi' graveyard at the last hour of night and say these words.

name: Funeral prayers #1
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say in funeral prayer:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا اَللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَصَغِيْرِنَا وَكَبِيْرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَاُنْثَانَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا اَللّٰهُمَّ مَنْ اَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَاَحْيِهٖ عَلَى الْاِيْمَانِ وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهٗ عَلَى الْاِسْلَامِ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا اَجْرَهٗ وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهٗ
clean: اللهم اغفر لحينا وميتنا وصغيرنا وكبيرنا وذكرنا وانثانا وشاهدنا وغاءبنا اللهم من احييته منا فاحيه علي الايمان ومن توفيته منا فتوفه علي الاسلام اللهم لا تحرمنا اجره ولا تضلنا بعده
transliteration: Allahum-maghfir lihayyinaa, wa mayyitinaa, wa sagheerinaa wa kabeerinaa, wa thakarinaa wa 'unthaanaa, wa shaahidinaa, wa ghaa'ibinaa. Allaahumma man 'ahyaytahu minnaa fa'ahyihi 'alal-'Imaan, wa man tawaffaytahu minnaa fatawaffahu 'alal-'Islam, Allaahumma laa tahrimnaa 'ajrahu wa laa tudhillanaa ba'dahu
translation: O Allah, forgive those of us who are living and those of us who are dead, those of us who are present and those of us who are absent, our young and our old, our male and our female. O Allah, to whomsoever of us You givest life grant him life as a believer, and whomsoever of us You takest in death take him in death as a follower of Islam. O Allah, do not withhold from us the reward (of faith) and do not lead us astray after his death.

name: Funeral prayers #2.1 (Male)
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ]
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهٗ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهٖ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَاَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهٗ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهٗ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهٖ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْاَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَاَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِّنْ دَارِهٖ وَاَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِّنْ اَهْلِهٖ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِّنْ زَوْجِهٖ وَاَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَاَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ]
clean: اللهم اغفر له وارحمه وعافه واعف عنه واكرم نزله ووسع مدخله واغسله بالماء والثلج والبرد ونقه من الخطايا كما نقيت الثوب الابيض من الدنس وابدله دارا خيرا من داره واهلا خيرا من اهله وزوجا خيرا من زوجه وادخله الجنه واعذه من عذاب القبر وعذاب النار
transliteration: Allahum-maghfir lahu warhamhu, wa 'aafihi, wa'fu 'anhu, wa 'akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi' mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bilmaa'i waththalji walbarad, wa naqqihi minal-khataayaa kamaa naqqaytath-thawbal-'abyadha minad-danas, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi, wa 'adkhilhul-jannata, wa 'a'idhhu min 'adhaabil-qabr (wa 'adhaabin-naar)
translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him and give him strength and pardon him. Be generous to him and cause his entrance to be wide and wash him with water and snow and hail. Cleanse him of his transgressions as white cloth is cleansed of stains. Give him an abode better than his home, and a family better than his family and a spouse better than his spouse. Take him into Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and from the punishment of Hell-fire].
note: Awf ibn Malik (RA) said, When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performed the funeral prayer, I memorized this dua from him. Hearing this dua, I wished that the dead body would be me! (The dua is Mentioned above)

name: Funeral prayers #2.2 (Male)
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ (إِنَّهُ) عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ كَانَ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُوْلُكَ وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي إِحْسَانِهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيْئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلَا تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ (اِنَّهُ) عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ وَابْنُ اَمَتِكَ كَانَ يَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ وَاَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُوْلُكَ وَاَنْتَ اَعْلَمُ بِهٖ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِيْ اِحْسَانِهٖ وَاِنْ كَانَ مُسِيْئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهٖ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا اَجْرَهٗ وَلَا تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهٗ
clean: اللهم انه عبدك وابن عبدك وابن امتك كان يشهد ان لا اله الا انت وان محمدا عبدك ورسولك وانت اعلم به اللهم ان كان محسنا فزد في احسانه وان كان مسيءا فتجاوز عن سيءاته اللهم لا تحرمنا اجره ولا تفتنا بعده
transliteration: Alla-humma, (innahu) ‘abduka, wabnu‘ 'abdika, wabnu amatika, ka-na yashhadu an laa ilaaha illa anta, wa anna mu’hmmadan ‘abduka wa rasooluka, wa aanta a'laamu bihi. Alla-humma, in kaana mu'hhsinan fajid fi e'hsaa-nihi, wa in ka-na musi-an fataja-waz ‘an saiyyi-aa-tihi. Alla-humma laa-ta'harimna-ajrahu, wala-taftinna ba'adahu
translation: O Allah, this man is Your servant, the son of Your male servant, the son of female servant. He testified that there is no true ilaah but you and that Muhammad (ﷺ) is your servant and your messenger. And you are more aware of it. O Allah, if he is a doer of good, then increase his goodness. And if he has sinned, then forgive him. O Allah, do not deprive us of His reward and do not tempt us after that.

name: Funeral prayers #2.3 (Male)
content: Narrated by Yazid Ibn Rukana Ibn Muttalib (RA): When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) perform Janazah prayer, he used to say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ اِحْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ اَمَتِكَ اِحْتَاجَ اِلٰى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَاَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهٖ، اِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِيْ حَسَنَاتِهٖ، وَاِنْ كَانَ مُسِيْئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهٗ
clean: اللهم عبدك وابن امتك احتاج الي رحمتك وانت غني عن عذابه ان كان محسنا فزد في حسناته وان كان مسيءا فتجاوز عنه
transliteration: Allaahumma 'abduka wabnu 'amatika ihtaaja 'ilaa rahmatika, wa 'Anta ghaniyyun 'an 'adhaabihi, 'in kaana mu'hsinan fazid fee hasanaatihi, wa 'in kaana musee'an fatajaawaz 'anhu
translation: O Allah, he is the son of One of Your male & female slave, he is in need of Your mercy, and You are not in need of his torment. If he was pious, then increase his rewards and if he was a sinner then pardon him.

name: Funeral prayers #2.4 (Male)
content: It is narrated on the authority of Wasila ibn al-Aska (RA) that he said, 'The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performed the janaza of a Muslim man with us. There I heard him said -
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ (فُلَانَ بْنَ فُلَانٍ) فِي ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ اَللَّهُمَّ فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ (فُلَانَ بْنَ فُلَانٍ) فِيْ ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَاَنْتَ اَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ اللّٰهُمَّ فَاغْفِرْ لَهٗ وَارْحَمْهٗ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
clean: اللهم ان فلان بن فلان في ذمتك وحبل جوارك فقه من فتنه القبر وعذاب النار وانت اهل الوفاء والحق اللهم فاغفر له وارحمه انك انت الغفور الرحيم
transliteration: Allaahumma 'inna (fulanabna fulan) fee dhimmatika, wa habli jiwaarika, faqihi min fitnatil-qabri wa 'adhaabin-naari, wa 'Anta 'ahlul-wafaa'i walhaqq. Allaahumma Faghfir lahu warhamhu 'innaka 'Antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem.
translation: O Allah, surely [name the person] is under Your protection, and in the rope of Your security, so save him from the trial of the grave and from the punishment of the Fire. You fulfill promises and grant rights, so forgive him and have mercy on him. Surely You are Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

name: Funeral prayers #3.1 (Female)
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا وَعَافِهَا وَاعْفُ عَنْهَا وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهَا وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهَا وَاغْسِلْهَا بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهَا مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهَا دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهَا وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهَا وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهَا وَأَدْخِلْهَا الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهَا مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ [عَذَابِ النَّارِ]
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا وَعَافِهَا وَاعْفُ عَنْهَا وَاَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهَا وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهَا وَاغْسِلْهَا بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهَا مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْاَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَاَبْدِلْهَا دَارًا خَيْرًا مِّنْ دَارِهَا وَاَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِّنْ اَهْلِهَا وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِّنْ زَوْجِهَا وَاَدْخِلْهَا الْجَنَّةَ وَاَعِذْهَا مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ [عَذَابِ النَّارِ]
clean: اللهم اغفر لها وارحمها وعافها واعف عنها واكرم نزلها ووسع مدخلها واغسلها بالماء والثلج والبرد ونقها من الخطايا كما نقيت الثوب الابيض من الدنس وابدلها دارا خيرا من دارها واهلا خيرا من اهلها وزوجا خيرا من زوجها وادخلها الجنه واعذها من عذاب القبر عذاب النار
transliteration: Allahum-maghfir laha warhamha, wa 'aafiha, wa'fu 'anha, wa 'akrim nuzulaha, wa wassi' mudkhalaha, waghsilha bilmaa'i waththalji walbarad, wa naqqiha minal-khataayaa kamaa naqqaytath-thawbal-'abyadha minad-danas, wa 'abdilha daaran khayran min daariha, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahliha, wa zawjan khayran min zawjiha, wa 'adkhilhal-jannata, wa 'a'idh-ha min 'adhaabil-qabr [or, 'adhaabin-naar instead of 'adhaabil-qabr].
translation: O Allah, forgive her and have mercy on her and give her strength and pardon her. Be generous to her and cause her entrance to be wide and wash her with water and snow and hail. Cleanse her of his transgressions as white cloth is cleansed of stains. Give her an abode better than her home, and a family better than her family and a spouse better than his spouse. Take her into Paradise and protect her from the punishment of the grave [and from the punishment of Hell-fire].

name: Funeral prayers #3.2 (Female)
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ (إِنَّهَا) أَمَتُكَ وَبِنْتُ عَبْدِكَ وَبِنْتُ أَمَتِكَ كَانَتْ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُوْلُكَ وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَتْ مُحْسِنَةً فَزِدْ فِي إِحْسَانِهَا وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مُسِيْئَةً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهَا اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهَا وَلَا تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهَا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ (اِنَّهَا) اَمَتُكَ وَبِنْتُ عَبْدِكَ وَبِنْتُ اَمَتِكَ كَانَتْ يَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ وَاَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُوْلُكَ وَاَنْتَ اَعْلَمُ بِهِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ كَانَتْ مُحْسِنَةً فَزِدْ فِيْ اِحْسَانِهَا وَاِنْ كَانَتْ مُسِيْئَةً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهَا اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا اَجْرَهَا وَلَا تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهَا
clean: اللهم انها امتك وبنت عبدك وبنت امتك كانت يشهد ان لا اله الا انت وان محمدا عبدك ورسولك وانت اعلم به اللهم ان كانت محسنه فزد في احسانها وان كانت مسيءه فتجاوز عن سيءاتها اللهم لا تحرمنا اجرها ولا تفتنا بعدها
transliteration: Alla-humma, (innaha) ‘amatuka, wa bintu 'abdika, wa bintu amatika, kaanat yashhadu an laa ilaaha illaa anta, wa anna mu’hammadan ‘abduka wa rasooluka, wa aanta a’lamu bihi. Alla-humma, in kaanat mu'hsinatan fajid fi ehsaa-niha, wa in kaanat musi-atan fataja-waz ‘an saiyyi-aa-tiha. Alla-humma laa-ta'harimna-ajraha, wala-taftinna ba'adaha.
translation: O Allah, this woman is Your servant, the daughter of Your male servant, the daughter of female servant. She testified that there is no true ilaah but you and that Muhammad (ﷺ) is your servant and your messenger. And you are more aware of it. O Allah, if she is a doer of good, then increase her goodness. And if she has sinned, then forgive her. O Allah, do not deprive us of her reward and do not tempt us after that.

name: Funeral prayers #3.3 (Female)
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَمَتُكَ وَبِنْتُ أَمَتِكَ اِحْتَاجَتْ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهَا، إِنْ كَانَتْ مُحْسِنَةً فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهَا، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مُسِيئَةً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهَا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَمَتُكَ وَبِنْتُ اَمَتِكَ اِحْتَاجَتْ اِلٰى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَاَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهَا، اِنْ كَانَتْ مُحْسِنَةً فَزِدْ فِيْ حَسَنَاتِهَا، وَاِنْ كَانَتْ مُسِيْئَةً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهَا
clean: اللهم امتك وبنت امتك احتاجت الي رحمتك وانت غني عن عذابها ان كانت محسنه فزد في حسناتها وان كانت مسيءه فتجاوز عنها
transliteration: Allaahumma ‛amatuka wabintu ‛amatika, i’htaajat ilaa ra’hmatika, wa anta ghaniyyun ‛an ‛adhaabiha, in kaanat mu’hsinatan fazid fee ‘hasanaatiha, wa in kaanat musee’atan fa tajaawaz ‛anha
translation: O Allah, she is the daughter of One of Your male & female slave, she is in need of Your mercy, and You are not in need of her torment. If she was pious then increase her rewards and if she was a sinner then pardon her.

name: Funeral prayers #3.4 (Female)
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ (فُلَانَةَ بِنْتُ فُلَانٍ) فِي ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، اَللَّهُمَّ فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ (فُلَانَةَ بِنْتُ فُلَانٍ) فِيْ ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَاَنْتَ اَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
clean: اللهم ان فلانه بنت فلان في ذمتك وحبل جوارك فقه من فتنه القبر وعذاب النار وانت اهل الوفاء والحق اللهم فاغفر لها وارحمها انك انت الغفور الرحيم
transliteration: Allaahumma 'inna (fulanata bintu fulan) fee dhimmatika, wa habli jiwaarika, faqihi min fitnatil-qabri wa 'adhaabin-naari, wa 'Anta 'ahlul-wafaa'i walhaqq. Allaahumma faghfir laha warhamha 'innaka 'Antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem
translation: O Allah, surely [name the person] is under Your protection, and in the rope of Your security, so save her from the trial of the grave and from the punishment of the Fire. You fulfill promises and grant rights, so forgive her and have mercy on her. Surely You are Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

name: Funeral prayers #4
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبُّهَا، وَأَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهَا، وَأَنْتَ هَدَيْتَهَا لِلْإِسْلَامِ، وَأَنْتَ قَبَضْتَ رُوْحَهَا، وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِسِرِّهَا وَعَلَانِيَتِهَا، جِئْنَا شُفَعَاءَ فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ رَبُّهَا، وَاَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهَا، وَاَنْتَ هَدَيْتَهَا لِلْاِسْلَامِ، وَاَنْتَ قَبَضْتَ رُوْحَهَا، وَاَنْتَ اَعْلَمُ بِسِرِّهَا وَعَلَانِيَتِهَا، جِئْنَا شُفَعَاءَ فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا
clean: اللهم انت ربها وانت خلقتها وانت هديتها للاسلام وانت قبضت روحها وانت اعلم بسرها وعلانيتها جءنا شفعاء فاغفر لها
transliteration: Alla-humma, anta rabbuhaa, wa anta khalaqtahaa, wa anta hadaitahaa lil islaam, wa anta qabadta ru'hahaa, wa anta a'lamu bisirriha wa 'ala-niyatihaa, ji'na shufa'a-a fagfir laha
translation: O Allah, You are his Lord, You have created him, You have shown him the way to Islam, You have accepted his soul, You know all his open and secrets. We have come to intercede for him, so forgive him.

name: Blessings at the child's funeral #1
content: Following Dua is good -
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطًا وَذُخْرًا لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعًا مُجَابًا، اَللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجُورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلَافِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطًا وَّذُخْرًا لِّوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيْعًا مُّجَابًا، اَللّٰهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهٖ مَوَازِيْنَهُمَا، وَاَعْظِمْ بِهٖ اُجُوْرَهُمَا، وَاَلْحِقْهٗ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، وَاجْعَلْهٗ فِيْ كَفَالَةِ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ، وَقِهٖ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِ، وَاَبْدِلْهٗ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِّنْ دَارِهٖ، وَاَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِّنْ اَهْلِهٖ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِاَسْلَافِنَا، وَاَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْاِيْمَانِ
clean: اللهم اجعله فرطا وذخرا لوالديه وشفيعا مجابا اللهم ثقل به موازينهما واعظم به اجورهما والحقه بصالح المءمنين واجعله في كفاله ابراهيم وقه برحمتك عذاب الجحيم وابدله دارا خيرا من داره واهلا خيرا من اهله اللهم اغفر لاسلافنا وافراطنا ومن سبقنا بالايمان
transliteration: Allahum-maj'alhu faratan wa dhukhran liwaalidayhi, wa shafee'an mujaaban. Allaahumma thaqqil bihi mawaazeenahumaa wa 'a'dhim bihi 'ujoorahumaa, wa 'alhiqhu bisaalihil-mu'mineen, waj'alhu fee kafaalati 'Ibraaheema, wa qihi birahmatika 'adhaabal-jaheem, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, Allahum-maghfir li'aslaafinaa, wa 'afraatinaa wa man sabaqanaa bil'eemaan.
translation: O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good) and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim (As). Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our lost children (by death), and those who have preceded us in Faith.
reference: See Al-Mughni, Lee Ibn Kudama, 3/416; See also Ad-Durusul Muhimmah Li ‘Ammatil Ummah, Lish Sheikh Abdil Aziz Ibn Abdillah Ibn Baz, Rahemahullah, p. 15.

name: Blessings at the child's funeral #2
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
clean: اللهم اعذه من عذاب القبر
transliteration: Allaahumma 'a'idh-hu min 'adhaabil-qabr
translation: O Allah, protect him from the torment of the grave.
note: Narrated by Sa’eed Ibn Musayyib (R) He said, "I perform janaza of a child behind Abu Hurairah (RA) who has never committed any sin." There I heard Abu Huraira (RA) say: (The dua is Mentioned above)

name: Blessings at the child's funeral #3
content: The famous Tabi'i Hasan Basri (R) used to recite Surah Fatiha at the janaza of child and recite the following du'a:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا سَلَفًا وَّفَرَطًا وَّأَجْرًا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا سَلَفًا وَّفَرَطًا وَّاَجْرًا
clean: اللهم اجعله لنا سلفا وفرطا واجرا
transliteration: Allahum-maj'alhu lanaa salafan, wa faratan, wa 'ajran
translation: O Allah, make him for us a precursor, a forerunner and a cause of reward.

name: Blessings after burying the dead person
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَثَبِّتْهُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهٗ وَثَبِّتْهٗ
clean: اللهم اغفر له وثبته
transliteration: Allahum-maghfir lahu wa thabbithu
translation: O Allah, forgive him, strengthen him (During question of grave)
note: Narrated Uthman ibn Affan (RA) : Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) became free from burying the dead, he used to stay at him (i.e. his grave) and say: Seek forgiveness for your brother, and beg steadfastness for him, for he will be questioned now.

name: Consolation to the relatives of the deceased
uthmani: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى وَكُلٌّ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى
indopak: اِنَّ لِلّٰهِ مَا اَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا اَعْطٰى وَكُلٌّ عِنْدَهُ بِاَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى
clean: ان لله ما اخذ وله ما اعطي وكل عنده باجل مسمي
transliteration: Inna lillaahi maa 'akhadha, wa lahu maa 'a'taa, wa kullun 'indahu bi'ajalin musamma
translation: Whatever Allah takes is His, and whatever He gives is His, and everything with Him has a limited fixed term (in this world).
note: Narrated by Usama bin Zaid (RA): We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when suddenly there came to him a messenger from one of his daughters who was asking him to come and see her son who was dying. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the messenger), (The dua is Mentioned above). So order her to be patient and hope for Allah's reward.

name: Dua for Consolation
content: It is better to recite this dua in giving condolence
uthmani: أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ
indopak: اَعْظَمَ اللّٰهُ اَجْرَكَ، وَاَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ
clean: اعظم الله اجرك واحسن عزاءك وغفر لميتك
transliteration: A'dhamAllahu 'ajraka, wa 'ahsana 'azaa'aka wa ghafara limayyitik.
translation: May Allah increase your reward, grant you the tawfiq of patience (in mourning), and forgive the dead person.

name: Dua of Laylatul Qadr
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ (كَرِيْمٌ) تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ (كَرِيْمٌ) تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّىْ
clean: اللهم انك عفو كريم تحب العفو فاعف عني
transliteration: Allaahumma innaka `Afuwwun [Karimun], tu'hibbul-`afwa fa`fu `annī.
translation: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning [Generous], You love pardon, so pardon me.
note:
Ayesha (RA) said, "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), should I make du'a on Lailatul Qadr?" Then he (ﷺ) taught me this du'a.

This du'aa 'can be recited in the prostration of Salat on Laylat al-Qadr, before Salam, after salaam and on all other days and nights in all Salats and at normal times.

name: Dua of the beginning of fasting
content: There is no masnun dua at the beginning of fasting. However, it is important to make the intention for fasting the night before the start of fasting. The conscious purpose in the mind is called intention. This is the intention of the believer to fast before fasting, before going to bed at night or during sahri. It is not Sunnah to say "Nawaituan" or to do so in any other way.

name: Upon sighting the crescent moon
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَهْلِلْهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيْمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ رَبِّيْ وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَهْلِلْهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْاِيْمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْاِسْلَامِ رَبِّيْ وَرَبُّكَ اللّٰهُ
clean: اللهم اهلله علينا باليمن والايمان والسلامه والاسلام ربي وربك الله
transliteration: Allaahumma ahlilhu `alaina bil-yumni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-Islam, rabbi wa rabbuk Allah
translation: O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and security and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.
note: Rasulullah (ﷺ) used to say this dua when he saw the new moon. It is masnun to recite this dua after seeing the new moon of Ramadan and all the months.

name: Dua recited during Iftar #1
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say when he breaks his fast:
uthmani: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَاءُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوْقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
indopak: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَاءُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوْقُ وَثَبَتَ الْاَجْرُ اِنْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ
clean: ذهب الظماء وابتلت العروق وثبت الاجر ان شاء الله
transliteration: Dhahabadh-dhama'u wabtallatil-'urooqu, wa thabatal-'ajru 'inshaa'Allah
translation: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
note:
Note that, the widely practiced hadith 

'Allahumma laka samtu wa 'ala rizqika aftartu'

but, the hadith is da'if (weak). [2]
reference:
[1] Hasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 2357
[2] Weak (Albany). Abu Dawud: 2358

name: Dua recited during Iftar #2
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِيْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ اَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِيْ
clean: اللهم اني اسالك برحمتك التي وسعت كل شيء ان تغفر لي
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka birahmatikal-latee wasi'at kulla shay'in 'an taghfira lee
translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, that You forgive me.
note: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) used to say this dua during Iftar.
reference: Hasan (Hafiz Ibn Hazar). Takhrijul Adhkar, Sharhul Adhkar: 4/342

name: Dua when insulted while fasting
uthmani: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
indopak: اِنِّيْ صَائِمٌ، اِنِّيْ صَائِمٌ
clean: اني صاءم اني صاءم
transliteration: Innee saa'imun, 'innee saa'imun
translation: I am fasting. I am fasting.
note: Narrated Abu Huraira (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Fasting is a shield; So if any one of you observes fasting, let him not commit adultery or foolishness; If someone fights him or insults him, let him say - (The dua is mentioned above)

name: When breaking fast in someone's home
uthmani: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
indopak: اَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُوْنَ، وَاَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْاَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
clean: افطر عندكم الصاءمون واكل طعامكم الابرار وصلت عليكم الملاءكه
transliteration: Aftara 'indakumus-saa'imoona, wa 'akala ta'aamakumul-'abraaru, wa sallat 'alaykumul-malaa'ikah.
translation: With you, those who are fasting have broken their fast, you have fed those who are righteous, and the angels recite their prayers upon you.

name: By one fasting when presented with food
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) says: If any one of you is invited to a meal when he is fasting, he should say:" I am fasting."

name: When mounting an animal or any means of transport
content: Rasulullah (ﷺ) used to say Bismillah while boarding the ride, he said the rest after setting down:
uthmani: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِيْنَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اَللّهُ أَكْبَرُ، (لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ) سُبْحَانَكَ، إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِيْ فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
indopak: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقْرِنِيْنَ وَاِنَّا اِلٰى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ، اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ، اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ، (لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ) سُبْحَانَكَ، اِنِّيْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِيْ فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ فَاِنَّهٗ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
clean: الحمد لله سبحان الذي سخر لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين وانا الي ربنا لمنقلبون الحمد لله الحمد لله الحمد لله الله اكبر الله اكبر الله اكبر لا اله الا انت سبحانك اني ظلمت نفسي فاغفر لي فانه لا يغفر الذنوب الا انت
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaah. Subhaanal-ladhee sakhkhara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahu muqrineen. Wa 'innaa 'ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon. Alhamdu lillaah, alhamdu lillaah, alhamdu lillaah, Allahu 'Akbar, Allahu 'Akbar, Allahu 'Akbar, (laa ilahaa 'illaa 'Anta) subhaanaka 'innee dhalamtu nafsee faghfir lee, fa'innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba 'illaa 'Anta
translation: Praise is to Allah. Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord we are returning. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Glory is to You. O Allah, I have wronged my own soul. Forgive me, for surely none forgives sins but You.

name: While returning from travel
content: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite this dua at the beginning of his journey:
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِيْنَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اَللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيْفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوْءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ، اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ، اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقْرِنِيْنَ، وَاِنَّا اِلٰى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَسْاَلُكَ فِيْ سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوٰى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضٰى، اَللّٰهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهٗ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيْفَةُ فِي الْاَهْلِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَّعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَاٰبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوْءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْاَهْلِ
clean: الله اكبر الله اكبر الله اكبر سبحان الذي سخر لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين وانا الي ربنا لمنقلبون اللهم انا نسالك في سفرنا هذا البر والتقوي ومن العمل ما ترضي اللهم هون علينا سفرنا هذا واطو عنا بعده اللهم انت الصاحب في السفر والخليفه في الاهل اللهم اني اعوذ بك من وعثاء السفر وكابه المنظر وسوء المنقلب في المال والاهل
transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar, Allahu 'Akbar, Allahu 'Akbar. Subhaanal-lathee sakhkhara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahu muqrineen. Wa 'innaa 'ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon. Allaahumma 'innaa nas'aluka fee safarinaa haadhal-birra wattaqwaa, waminal-'amali maa tardhaa, Allaahumma hawwin 'alaynaa safaranaa haadhaa watwi 'annaa bu'dahu, Allaahumma 'Antas-saahibu fis-safari, walkhaleefatu fil-'ahli, Allaahumma 'innee 'A'oodhu bika min wa'thaa'is-safari, wa ka-'aabatil-mandhari, wa soo'il-munqalabi fil-maali wal 'ahli
translation: Allah is the Most Great (3 times). Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You on this our journey for goodness and piety, and for works that are pleasing to You. O Allah, lighten this journey for us and make its distance easy for us. O Allah, You are our Companion on the road and the One in Whose care we leave our family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from this journey's hardships, and from the wicked sights in store and from finding our family and property in misfortune upon returning.

name: Dua of the resident for the traveller
uthmani: أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ اللَّهَ الَّذِيْ لَا تَضِيْعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
indopak: اَسْتَوْدِعُكَ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْ لَا تَضِيْعُ وَدَائِعُهٗ
clean: استودعك الله الذي لا تضيع وداءعه
transliteration: Astawdi'ukAllahal-ladhee laa tadhee'u wadaa'i'uhu
translation: I leave you in the care of Allah, as nothing is lost that is in His care.
note: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave me a send-off and said: (The dua is mentioned above). So, musaafir should say this dua to the farewell giver.But Musaafir and farewell giver both can supplicate this dua for each other.

name: Dua to bid farewell to the traveler #1
uthmani: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِيْنَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيْمَ عَمَلِكَ
indopak: اَسْتَوْدِعُ اللّٰهَ دِيْنَكَ وَاَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيْمَ عَمَلِكَ
clean: استودع الله دينك وامانتك وخواتيم عملك
transliteration: Astawdi'ullaaha deenaka, wa 'amaanataka, wa khawaateema 'amalika
translation: I leave your religion in the care of Allah, as well as your safety, and the last of your deeds.
note: Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) said, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: when he bid farewell, he grab his hand and did musafaha and said the above mentioned dua.In another narration, Abdullah Ibn Yazid Khatmi (RA) said, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bid farewell by saying these words. But in this case, he used plural (kum) instead of singular (ka): “Astad’iullaha diinaakum wa amaanatakum wa khawatima a’maalikum” I leave your religion in the care of Allah, as well as your safety, and the last of your deeds.

name: Dua to bid farewell to the traveler #2
uthmani: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى وَغَفَرَ لَكَ ذَنْبَكَ وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ
indopak: زَوَّدَكَ اللّٰهُ التَّقْوٰى وَغَفَرَ لَكَ ذَنْۢبَكَ وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ
clean: زودك الله التقوي وغفر لك ذنبك ويسر لك الخير حيثما كنت
transliteration: Zawwadakal-laahut-taqwaa, wa ghafara thanbaka, wa yassara lakal-khayra haythu maa kunta
translation: May Allah give you piety as your provision, forgive your sins, and make goodness easy for you wherever you are.
note: Anas ibn Malik (RA) said, "A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said, 'I have decided to travel. Give me a Travel allowance.' Then he said these words and prayed for him.

name: Dua of the traveller for the resident #1
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
clean: اعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من شر ما خلق
transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq
translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
note: We have seen that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: If a person goes to a place or stops somewhere on a journey and says this dua, then nothing can harm him while he is there.

name: Dua of the traveller for the resident #2
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ رَّبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الْأَرَضِيْنَ السَّبْعِ ومَا أَقْلَلْنَ، ورَبَّ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ ومَا أَضْلَلْنَ، ورَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، (وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا) وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا وشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا اَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الْاَرَضِيْنَ السَّبْعِ ومَا اَقْلَلْنَ، ورَبَّ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ ومَا اَضْلَلْنَ، ورَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، اَسْاَلُكَ خَيْرَ هٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ اَهْلِهَا، (وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيْهَا) وَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ اَهْلِهَا وشَرِّ مَا فِيْهَا
clean: اللهم رب السماوات السبع وما اظللن ورب الارضين السبع وما اقللن ورب الشياطين وما اضللن ورب الرياح وما ذرين اسالك خير هذه القريه وخير اهلها وخير ما فيها ونعوذ بك من شرها وشر اهلها وشر ما فيها
transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i wa maa 'adhlalna, wa Rabbal-'aradheenas-sab'i wa maa 'aqlalna, wa Rabbash-shayaateeni wa maa 'adhlalna, wa Rabbar-riyaahi wa maa tharayna. 'As'aluka khayra haathihil-qaryati wa khayra 'ahlihaa, (wa khayra maa feehaa), wa na‛oodhu bika min sharrihaa, wa sharri 'ahlihaa, wa sharri maa feehaa
translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they overshadow, Lord of the seven worlds and all they uphold, Lord of the devils and all they lead astray, Lord of the winds and all they scatter. I ask You for the goodness of this town and for the goodness of its people, and for the goodness it contains. I seek refuge in You from its evil, from the evil of its people and from the evil it contains.
note: Suhaib (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say these words whenever he saw a town before entering it.

name: When entering the market
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَخَيْرِ أَهْلِهَا وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَخَيْرِ اَهْلِهَا وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ اَهْلِهَا
clean: اللهم اني اسالك من خيرها وخير اهلها واعوذ بك من شرها وشر اهلها
transliteration: Allaahumma inni As'aluka min khayrihaa wa khayri 'ahlihaa wa 'a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa, wa sharri 'ahlihaa
translation: Ya Allah! I ask you for the blessing of this place and the goodness of it’s inhabitant’s. And I take refuge in you from harm of this place and harm of it’s inhabitant’s.
note: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) that he stood at the entrance of the market, recited the du'a and entered the market.

name: When entering the market
content: Umar ibnul khattab (RA) narrated that: the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Whoever enters the marketplace and says:
uthmani: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
indopak: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِيْ وَيُمِيْتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَّا يَمُوْتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
clean: لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد يحيي ويميت وهو حي لا يموت بيده الخير وهو علي كل شيء قدير
transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyee wa yumeetu, wa Huwa hayyun laa yamootu, biyadihil-khayru, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer
translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partener. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He brings life and He causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His Hand is all good, and He is Able to do all things.
note: Allah will write a million rewards for him, remove a million sins from him and raise his status by one million levels.

name: When the mounted animal (or mean of transport) stumbles
content: Abu al-Malih (RA) reported on the authority of a man: I was riding on a mount behind the prophet (ﷺ) It stumbled. Thereupon I said: May the devil perish! He said: do not say; may the devil perish! For you say that, he will swell so much so that he will be like a house, and say: by my power. But say: (The dua is mentioned above)
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ
clean: بسم الله
transliteration: Bismillaah
translation: With the Name of Allah.
note: Abu al-Malih (RA) reported on the authority of a man : I was riding on a mount behind the prophet (ﷺ). It stumbled. Thereupon I said: May the devil perish! He said: do not say; may the devil perish! For you say that, he will swell so much so that he will be like a house, and say: by my power. But say: (The dua is mentioned above) For when you say that, he will diminish so much so that he will be like a fly.

name: Recitation of Takbeer and Tasbeeh during the tour
content: Narrated Jabir bin Abdillah (RA): He said, "When we ascended, we would say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu Akbar
translation: Allah is the Most Great.

name: Prayer of the traveller when dawn approach
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say at the end of the night while on a journey:
uthmani: سَمِعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلَائِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
indopak: سَمِعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللّٰهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلَائِهٖ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا، وَاَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذًا بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
clean: سمع سامع بحمد الله وحسن بلاءه علينا ربنا صاحبنا وافضل علينا عاءذا بالله من النار
transliteration: Sami'a saami'un bihamdillaahi wa husni balaa'ihi 'alaynaa. Rabbanaa saahibnaa, wa 'afdhil 'alaynaa 'aa'ithan billaahi minan-naar.
translation: He Who listens has heard that we praise Allah for the good things He gives us. Our Lord, be with us and bestow Your favor upon us. I seek the protection of Allah from the Fire.

name: While returning from travel
content: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah ibn' Umar (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to rise on every high ground on the way back from a battle or Hajj or 'Umrah and say three times:
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu Akbar
translation: Allah is the Most Great.

name: Dua for mounting boat/ship
content: Noah (AS) took a boat ride while reading the following prayer:
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسٰىهَآ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسٰىهَا اِنَّ رَبِّىْ لَغَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
clean: بسم الله مجراها ومرسيها ان ربي لغفور رحيم
transliteration: Bismillahi majraha wa mursaha inna rabbee laGhafoorur-Raheem
translation: In the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.
note: Note that, this Dua cannot be said while mounting an animal or any means of transport. However, in our country, this dua is written in front of many vehicles and the supervisor says this dua when starting the journey, which is wrong.

name: When out on tour
content: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out on a journey, he would sit on the back of his camel and say three times:
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu Akbar
translation: Allah is the Most Great.

name: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
content:
Allah says:

Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [ Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allah to grant him] peace.

name: Dua for traveler #1
content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to recite this du'a when he was on a journey:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ اَللَّهُمَّ اطْوِ لَنَا الْأَرْضَ وَهَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا السَّفَرَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيْفَةُ فِي الْاَهْلِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَّعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَاٰبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَسُوْءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْاَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اطْوِ لَنَا الْاَرْضَ وَهَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا السَّفَرَ
clean: اللهم انت الصاحب في السفر والخليفه في الاهل اللهم اني اعوذ بك من وعثاء السفر وكابه المنقلب وسوء المنظر في الاهل والمال اللهم اطو لنا الارض وهون علينا السفر
transliteration: Allaahumma 'Antas-saahibu fis-safari wal-khaleefatu fil-'ahli, Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oodhu bika min wa'thaa'is-safari, wa kaabatil munqalabi wa su'il manzari fil-ahli wal maali, Allaahummatwi lanal-arda wa hawwin alainas-safara
translation: O Allah, You are the Companion in the journey, and the One Who looks after the family; O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the difficulty of travelling, finding harm when I return, and unhappiness in what I see coming to my family and property. O Allah, make the length of his journey short for us, and the journey easy for us.

name: Dua for traveler #2
content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to recite this du'a when he was on a journey:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِيْ هَذَا مِنَ الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اَللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا الْمَسِيرَ وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَ الْأَرْضِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ اَللَّهُمَّ اصْحَبْنَا فِي سَفَرِنَا وَاخْلُفْنَا فِي أَهْلِنَا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ فِيْ سَفَرِيْ هَذَا مِنَ الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوٰى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضٰى، اَللّٰهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا الْمَسِيْرَ وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَ الْاَرْضِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيْفَةُ فِي الْاَهْلِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَصْحَبْنَا فِيْ سَفَرِنَا وَاخْلُفْنَا فِيْ اَهْلِنَا
clean: اللهم اني اسالك في سفري هذا من البر والتقوي ومن العمل ما ترضي اللهم هون علينا المسير واطو عنا بعد الارض اللهم انت الصاحب في السفر والخليفه في الاهل اللهم اصحبنا في سفرنا واخلفنا في اهلنا
transliteration: Allaahumma inni as’aluka fi safari hadha minal-birri wat-taqwa, wa minal-`amali maa tarda. Allaahumma hawwin `alainal-masira, watwi `anna bu`dal-ard. Allaahumma antas-saahibu fis safari wal-khalifatu fil-ahli. Allaahumma ashaabna fi safarina wakhlufna fi ahlina
translation: O Allah, I ask You in this journey of mine from the righteousness and piety and actions that which you are pleased with. O Allah, ease for us the path, and make near for us the distance of the land. O Allah, You are the companion in the journey, and the caretaker for the family. O Allah, accompany us in our journey, and take care of our families

name: Hajj/Umrah - Talbiya
uthmani: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
indopak: لَبَّيْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، اِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ
clean: لبيك اللهم لبيك لبيك لا شريك لك لبيك ان الحمد والنعمه لك والملك لا شريك لك
transliteration: Labbayk Allaahumma labbayk, labbayka laa shareeka laka labbayk, 'innal-hamda, wanni'mata, laka wal mulk, laa shareeka lak.
translation: I am here at Your service, O Allah, I am here at Your service. I am here at Your service, You have no partener, I am here at Your service. Surely the praise, and blessings are Yours, and the dominion. You have no partener.
note: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reciting this talbiyyah with his hair tied together. (The Dua is motioned above) He did not utter more words than this.

name: Uttering takbir when passing the black stone
content: Narrated Ibn `Abbas (RA): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Tawaf (of the Ka`ba) ending a camel (at that time the Prophet [ﷺ] had foot injury). Whenever he came to the Corner (having the Black Stone) he would point out towards it with a thing in his hand and say, "Allahu-Akbar."

name: Between the Yemeni corner and black stone [of Ka'bah]
uthmani: رَبَّنَا اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
indopak: رَبَّنَا اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
clean: ربنا اتنا في الدنيا حسنه وفي الاخره حسنه وقنا عذاب النار
transliteration: Rabbanaa 'aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-'aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa 'athaaban-naar
translation: Our Lord, grant us the good things in this world and the good things in the next life and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
note: Narrated Abdullah Ibn Sa'ib (RA): I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recite this prayer in the middle of two rukans. (The dua is Mentioned above)

name: The dua at the day of 'Arafah
content: Narrated by Amr Ibn Shuaib (RA) from his grandfather through his father, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, “The best dua is the dua on the day of Arafa. The best prayer I and my predecessors have read is -
uthmani: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
indopak: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
clean: لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد وهو علي كل شيء قدير
transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer
translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without any partener. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.
note: Narrated by Amr Ibn Shuaib (RA) from his grandfather through his father, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, “The best dua is the dua on the day of Arafa. The best prayer I and my predecessors have read is - (The dua is Mentioned above)

name: Sacred Site [al-Mash'ar al-Haraam] - At Muzdalifa
content: Narrated Jabir Ibn Abdillah (RA): At one point in his long hadith of the Hajj of the Prophet (ﷺ), he said, “Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) lay down until dawn. After the morning became clear, he performed the Fajr prayer with one Azan and one Iqamah. Then he came to Al-Mash'arul Haram on a Qaswaa [1].There he turned to the Qibla and supplicated to Allah and proclaimed the superiority, sovereignty and unity of Allah. He stayed there until the morning light became extremely bright. Then he left before the sun rose.' [2]
reference:
[1] The name of the vehicle of the Prophet (ﷺ)
[2] Muslim: 1218

name: When throwing each pebble at the Jamarat
content:
Ibn `Umar (RA) used to do Rami of the Jamrat-ud-Dunya (the Jamra near to the Khaif mosque) with seven small stones and used to recite Takbir on throwing every pebble. He then would go ahead till he reached the level ground where he would stand facing the Qibla for a long time to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands (while invoking). 

Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Wusta (middle Jamra) and then he would go to the left towards the middle ground, where he would stand facing the Qibla. He would remain standing there for a long period to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands, and would stand there for a long period. 

Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Aqaba from the middle of the valley, but he would not stay by it, and then he would leave and say, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) doing like this."

name: Takbir when passing the black stone
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar
translation: Allah is the Most Great.
note: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Tawaf (of the Ka`ba) ending a camel (at that time the Prophet [ﷺ] had foot injury). Whenever he came to the Corner (having the Black Stone) he would point out towards it with a thing in his hand and say, "Allahu-Akbar." (The dua is Mentioned above)

name: Sacred Site [al-Mash'ar al-Haraam] - At Muzdalifa
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) rode on a camel called 'Kaswa'.When he finally came to Mash'arul Haram (a place in Muzdalifah), he prayed facing the Qibla and said takbeer -
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar
translation: Allah is the Most Great.

name: When throwing each pebble at the Jamarat
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say when throwing pebbles in three jamarat:
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar
translation: Allah is the Most Great.
note: Then he would move forward a little and stand facing the Qibla and would do Dua with both hands raised in the first Jamra and the second Jamra. But at the time of throwing every pebble at Jamratul Akbaba, he would say ‘Allahu Akbar’ and return without staying there.

name: Which dua should be read while standing in Safa and Marwa
content: When the Prophet (ﷺ) approached mount as-Safaa he would recite:
uthmani: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ
indopak: اِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللّٰهِ
clean: ان الصفا والمروه من شعاءر الله
transliteration: Inna assafa wal-marwata min shaAAa-iri Allah
translation: Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. [1]

name: Dua of sacrifice #1
content: Jundub bin Abdullah (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said that the sacrificer will sacrifice by saying ‘Bismillah-h’.
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ
clean: بسم الله
transliteration: Bismillaah
translation: In the name of Allah.

name: Dua of sacrifice #2
content: Anas (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) placed his feet on the two jaws of a goat with white and black horns and sacrificed him saying Bismillahi wAllahu akbar.
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: بسم الله والله اكبر
transliteration: Bismillaahi wAllahu 'Akbar
translation: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great!

name: What to say when slaughtering an animal
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اَللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ [اَللّٰهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اَللّٰهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّيْ
clean: بسم الله والله اكبر اللهم منك ولك اللهم تقبل مني
transliteration: Bismillaahi wAllahu 'Akbar [Allaahumma minka wa laka] Allaahumma taqabbal minnee
translation: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great! [O Allah, from You and to You.] O Allah, accept it from me.

name: What the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say at the time of slaughtering #1
content: Prophet (ﷺ) used to say at the time of slaughter -
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمِنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ اَللّٰهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنْ مُّحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّمِنْ اُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ
clean: بسم الله اللهم تقبل من محمد وال محمد ومن امه محمد
transliteration: Bismillaahi, Allah-humma Taqabbal min Muhammadin wa Al-i-Muhammadin, wa min Ummati Muhammadin
translation: In the name of Allah, O Allah, accept it from Muhammad, Muhammad's family and from Muhammad's Ummah (followers)
note: Then he sacrificed it.

name: What the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say at the time of slaughtering #2
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say during the slaughter-
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ هَذَا عَنِّي وَعَمَّنْ لَمْ يُضَحِّ مِنْ أُمَّتِي
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ هٰذَا عَنِّيْ وَعَمَّنْ لَّمْ يُضَحِّ مِنْ اُمَّتِيْ
clean: بسم الله والله اكبر هذا عني وعمن لم يضح من امتي
transliteration: Bismillah-hi wallahu akbaru haza 'anni wa amman lam udahh-hi min ummati
translation: In the name of Allah, Allah is Most Great. This is from me and from those who did not sacrifice from my community.

name: Pray to Allah for refuge from Satan
content:
Allah says:

And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

name: What should be said to chase shaytaan
content:
1. Seek refuge in Allah from Satan;
2. Give Azan [1]
3. Remembrance and recitation of the Qur'an;  And [2]
4. Spitting three times on the left during salah and recitation of the Qur'an.

Moreover, the other things that drive away the devils are the adhkaar of morning and evening, the adhkaar of sleep, the adhkaar of awakening, the adhkaar of entering and leaving the house, the adhkaar of entering and leaving the mosque, etc., and those adhkaar which are according to the Shari'ah. For example, Ayatul Kursi, the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah during sleep. Moreover, the person who recites "La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu, wahua 'ala qulli shayin qadir" a hundred times, will give him complete protection for that day. Also giving the Azan, Satan fled.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, “Do not turn your houses into graves. Surely Satan flees from the house where Surah Al-Baqarah is recited.” [Muslim: 780]

name: Dua for expelling the devil and his whisperings #1
content: Seek refuge in Allah from Satan by this dua-
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
clean: اعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم
transliteration: A‛oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

name: Dua for expelling the devil and his whisperings #2
uthmani: رَبِّ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَّحْضُرُونِ
indopak: رَبِّ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ، وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ رَبِّ اَنْ يَّحْضُرُوْنِ
clean: رب اعوذ بك من همزات الشياطين واعوذ بك رب ان يحضرون
transliteration: Rabbi A‛oodhu bika min hamazatish shayaateen, Wa A‛oodhu bika rabbi ay-yahduroon
translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, And my Lord, I seek refuge from they be present with me.

name: Dua for expelling the devil and his whisperings #3
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ السَّمِيْعِ الْعَلِيْمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهٖ وَنَفْخِهٖ وَنَفْثِهٖ
clean: اعوذ بالله السميع العليم من الشيطان الرجيم من همزه ونفخه ونفثه
transliteration: A‛oodhu Billa-Hish Sami’il-‘Alimi Minash Shaytaanir rajeem Min Hamzihi Wa Nafkhihi Wa Nafthihi
translation: I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing and the All-Knowing from the accursed devil, from his madness or evil suggestion (Hamz), from his puffing up (Nafkh), and from his witchcraft (Nafth).

name: Dua when afflicted by whisperings of the devil in prayer or recitation
content: If you notice the presence of Satan in the prayer, say this dua and spit three times on the left side -
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
clean: اعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم
transliteration: A‛oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

name: When you enter the mosque, seek refuge from the devil #1
content: When entering the mosque, say -
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيْمِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيْمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
clean: اعوذ بالله العظيم وبوجهه الكريم وسلطانه القديم من الشيطان الرجيم
transliteration: A‛oodhu Billaahil ‘Azeem, Wabi Wazhihil Kareem, Wa Sultaanihil Qadeem Minash Shaytaanir rajeem
translation: I seek refuge in Allah, the Magnificent, and in His noble face, and in his eternal domain, from the accursed Devil.
note: Uqbah (RA) said, ‘When someone recites this du’a, the devil says, ‘This man escaped from me (evil and intrigue) for the whole day.

name: When you enter the mosque, seek refuge from the devil #2
content: When entering the mosque, say -
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِيْ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
clean: اللهم اعصمني من الشيطان الرجيم
transliteration: Allaahumma`simni min ash-shaytaanir-rajeem
translation: O Allah, protect me from Satan the outcast.

name: Seeking refuge from the devil when leaving the mosque
content: Abu Hurairah (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) instructed to recite this dhikr while leaving the mosque -
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِيْ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَجِرْنِيْ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
clean: اللهم اجرني من الشيطان الرجيم
transliteration: Allaahumma, ajirni minash Shaytaanir rajeem
translation: O Allah, protect me from Satan the outcast.

name: Satan's enmity towards the newborn
content: Narrated by Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When any human being is born. Satan touches him at both sides of the body with his two fingers, except Esa (As), the son of Mary, whom Satan tried to touch but failed, for he touched the placenta-cover instead."

name: Prayers and answers for the father of the newborn #1
content: It is narrated on the authority of Husain (RA) that he went to teach a man how to give greetings and said, You will say:
uthmani: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
indopak: بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ فِى الْمَوْهُوْبِ لَكَ وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ وَبَلَغَ اَشُدَّهٗ وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهٗ
clean: بارك الله لك في الموهوب لك وشكرت الواهب وبلغ اشده ورزقت بره
transliteration: BaarakAllahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-waahiba, wa balagha 'ashuddahu, wa ruziqta birrahu.
translation: May Allah bless you with His gift to you, and may you (the new parent) give thanks (to Allah - the giver), may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness.

name: Prayers and answers for the father of the newborn #2
content: It is better to give such a reply to the greeter -
uthmani: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ وَأَجْزَلَ اللَّهُ ثَوَابَكَ
indopak: بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَزَاكَ اللّٰهُ خَيْرًا وَرَزَقَكَ اللّٰهُ مِثْلَهٗ وَاَجْزَلَ اللّٰهُ ثَوَابَكَ
clean: بارك الله لك وبارك عليك وجزاك الله خيرا ورزقك الله مثله واجزل الله ثوابك
transliteration: Baarakallahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jazaakAllahu khayran, wa razaqakAllahu mithlahu, wa 'ajzalallahu thawaabaka
translation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly.
reference: This is what Imam Nawabi in his Al-Azkar text p.  256/349 mentioned

name: Children and others to the shelter of Allah's blessings
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to seek Refuge with Allah for Hasan (RA) and Husain (RA) and say:
uthmani: أُعِيذُكُمَا [أَعُوْذُ] بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
indopak: اُعِيْذُكُمَا [اَعُوْذُ] بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَّهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَّامَّةٍ
clean: اعيذكما اعوذ بكلمات الله التامه من كل شيطان وهامه ومن كل عين لامه
transliteration: Oo-'idhukumaa (For self: A'ooudhu) bi kalimaat-illaahit-taammati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah, wa min kulli ‛aynin laammah
translation: I commend you to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.
note: The Prophet (ﷺ) say: "Your forefather Ibrahim (AS) used to seek Refuge with Allah for Ishmael (AS) and Isaac (AS) by reciting this dua.

name: Praying to Allah for refuge from the evil of something
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّآمَّآتِ الَّتِيْ لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَّلَا فَاجِرٌ مِّنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَاَ وَذَرَاَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَاَ فِي الْاَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ اِلَّا طَارِقًا يَّطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَّا رَحْمٰنُ
clean: اعوذ بكلمات الله التامات التي لا يجاوزهن بر ولا فاجر من شر ما خلق وبرا وذرا ومن شر ما ينزل من السماء ومن شر ما يعرج فيها ومن شر ما ذرا في الارض ومن شر ما يخرج منها ومن شر فتن الليل والنهار ومن شر كل طارق الا طارقا يطرق بخير يا رحمن
transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaatil-latee laa yujaawizuhunna barrun wa laa faajirum min sharri maa khalaqa, wa bara'a wa dhara'a, wa min sharri maa yanzilu minas-samaa'i, wa min sharri maa ya'ruju feehaa, wa min sharri maa dhara'a fil-'ardhi, wa min sharri ma yakhruju minhaa, wa min sharri fitanil-layli wannahaari, wa min sharri kulli taariqin 'illaa taariqan yatruqu bikhayrin yaa Rahmaan
translation: I take refuge within Allah's perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. [I take refuge] from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. [I take refuge] from the evil that is spread on earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.

name: If something unpleasant happens
uthmani: قَدَّرَ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
indopak: قَدَّرَ اللّٰهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
clean: قدر الله وما شاء فعل
transliteration: Qaddar-Allahu wa maa shaa’a fa‛al
translation: Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.
note: Abu Huraira (RA) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A strong believer is better and is more lovable to Allah than a weak believer, and there is good in everyone, (but) cherish that which gives you benefit (in the Hereafter) and seek help from Allah and do not lose heart, and if anything (in the form of trouble) comes to you, don't say: If I had not done that, it would not have happened so and so, but say: (The dua is Mentioned above) your "if" opens the (gate) for the Satan.

name: When faced with a difficult matter
content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ اِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهٗ سَهْلًا، وَاَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ اِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
clean: اللهم لا سهل الا ما جعلته سهلا وانت تجعل الحزن اذا شءت سهلا
transliteration: Allaahumma laa sahla 'illaa maa ja'altahu sahlan wa 'Anta taj'alul-hazna 'ithaa shi'ta sahla
translation: O Allah, there is no ease other than what You make easy. If you want you can make difficult matter easy.

name: If any sin occurred
content:
Narrated by Ali ibn abu Talib: Abu Bakr narrated to me a hadith, and Abu Bakr narrated it truthfully. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: When a servant (of Allah) commits a sin, and he performs ablution well, and then stands and prays two rak'ahs, and asks pardon of Allah, Allah pardons him. He then recited this verse:

And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allah? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know. Those - their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens beneath which rivers flow [in Paradise], wherein they will abide eternally; and excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers.(Surah Al 'Imran 3: 135-136)

name: Dua upon hearing the crowing of a rooster, the braying of a donkey or the barking of a dog at night
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيـمِ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
clean: اعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم
transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
note:
The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you hear the crowing of rooster, ask for Allah's Blessings for (their crowing indicates that) they have seen an angel. And when you hear the braying of donkeys, seek Refuge with Allah from Satan for (their braying indicates) that they have seen a Satan. [1]

In another narration when you hear the rooster crowing, ask Allah for some of His grace, for they have seen as angel; but when you hear donkey braying, seek refuge in Allah from the devil, for it has seen the devil. [2]

name: If afflicted with doubt in one's faith #1
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
clean: اعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم
transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
note: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Satan comes to one of you and says, 'Who created so-and-so? 'till he says, 'Who has created your Lord?' So, when he inspires such a question, When he reaches that stage, he should say - (The dua is mentioned above)

name: If afflicted with doubt in one's faith #2
uthmani: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
indopak: اٰمَنْتُ بِاللّٰهِ وَرُسُلِهٖ
clean: امنت بالله ورسله
transliteration: Aamantu billaahi wa Rusulihi
translation: I believe in Allah and His Messenger.
note: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Men will continue to question one another till this is propounded: Allah created all things but who created Allah? He who found himself confronted with such a situation should say: (The dua is Mentioned above)

name: If afflicted with doubt in one's faith #3
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَحَدٌ اَللّٰهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ یَلِدْ وَلَمْ یُوْلَدْ وَلَمْ یَكُنْ لَّهٗ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ
clean: الله احد الله الصمد لم لد ولم ولد ولم كن له كفوا احد
transliteration: Allahu 'Ahad. Allahus-Samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan 'ahad
translation: He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
note:
Abu Hurairah (RA) reported that Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: People will continue to ask one another(questions) till this is pronounced: Allah created all things, but who created Allah ? Whoever comes across anything of that, he should say: (The dua is mentioned above)

Then he spit three times on his left side, seeking refuge with Allah from Satan.

name: If afflicted with doubt in one's faith #4
content: When doubt in belive comes to your mind, you say -
uthmani: هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
indopak: هُوَ الْاَوَّلُ وَالْاٰخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ
clean: هو الاول والاخر والظاهر والباطن وهو بكل شيء عليم
transliteration: Huwal-'Awwalu wal-'Aakhiru wadh-Dhaahiru wal-Baatinu, wa Huwa bikulli shay'in 'Aleem
translation: He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near. And He is the Knower of all things. (Sura Al-Hadid 57:3)
note:
