Abu Zumayl (RA) said: I asked Ibn Abbas (RA), I have a difficult question in my mind. He asked: What is it? I replied: I swear by Allah, I cannot speak about it. He asked me: Is it something doubtful? and he laughed. He then said: No one could escape that, until Allah, the exalted, revealed:

(94) So if you are in doubt, [O Muhammad], about that which We have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord, so never be among the doubters. (95) And never be of those who deny the signs of Allah and [thus] be among the losers. (Sura Yunus 10:94-95)

name: Seeking refuge from the torment of the grave and the Dajjal
uthmani: نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ
indopak: نَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ نَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ نَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ نَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ
clean: نعوذ بالله من عذاب النار نعوذ بالله من عذاب القبر نعوذ بالله من الفتن ما ظهر منها وما بطن نعوذ بالله من فتنه الدجال
transliteration: NA‛oodhu billaahi min ‘adhaabin naar. NA‛oodhu billaahi min ‘adhaabil qabr. NA‛oodhu billaahi minal fitaani maa zahara minhaa wa maa batan. NA‛oodhu billaahi min fitnatid dajjaal
translation: We seek refuge with Allah from the torment of Hell, Seek refuge with Allah from the torment of the grave. We seek refuge with Allah from turmoil and its visible and invisible aspects. We seek refuge with Allah from the turmoil of the Dajjal.

name: Dua in an angry state
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
clean: اعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم
transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
note:
Allah says:

And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

name: Prayer for the suppression of anger #1
content: Narrated by Sulaiman bin Surad: A man from the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Two men abused each other in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) and one of them became angry and his anger became so intense that his face became swollen and changed. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I know a word the saying of which will cause him to relax if he does say it." Then a man went to him and informed him of the statement of the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Seek refuge with Allah from Satan." On that, angry man said, 'Do you find anything wrong with me? Am I insane? Go away!"

name: Prayer for the suppression of anger #2
content: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger."

name: Masnun Istegfar #1
uthmani: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
indopak: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ
clean: استغفر الله
transliteration: astaghfir-ullaah
translation: I seek Allah’s forgiveness.

name: Masnun Istegfar #2
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite more than seventy times a day:
uthmani: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوْبُ إِلَيْهِ
indopak: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ وَاَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ
clean: استغفر الله واتوب اليه
transliteration: astaghfir-ullaaha wa atuwb 'iilayhi
translation: I seek forgiveness of God and repent to him.

name: Masnun Istegfar #3
content: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar (RA): We counted that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would say this dua a hundred times during a meeting -
uthmani: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ (الْغَفُوْرُ)
indopak: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ (الغَفُوْرُ)
clean: رب اغفر لي وتب علي انك انت التواب الرحيم الغفور
transliteration: Rabbighfirli Watub Alayya Innaka Antat-Tawwabul- rahim  [in another narration there is al-Ghaffur instead of al-Rahim]
translation: Lord, forgive me and repent for me, for you are The Most Merciful The Acceptor of Repentance. In another narration there is "The Forgiver" instead of "The Acceptor of Repentance"

name: Masnun Istegfar #4
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) added: The person who says:
uthmani: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِيْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
indopak: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ الْعَظِيْمَ الَّذِيْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ وَاَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ
clean: استغفر الله العظيم الذي لا اله الا هو الحي القيوم واتوب اليه
transliteration: Astaghfirulla-hal adhemal-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huwal hayyul qayyoomu wa atoobu ilayhi
translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Living, the Eternal, and I repent to Him.
note:
Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army." [1]

He (ﷺ) said: "The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so." [2]

He (ﷺ) also said: "The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein." [3]

He (ﷺ) also said: "Verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah"s forgiveness a hundred times a day." [4]
reference:
[1] Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1517
[2] Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3579
[3] Muslim: 482
[4] Muslim: 2702

name: Masnun Istegfar #5
uthmani: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
indopak: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ الْحَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
clean: لا اله الا الله الحليم الكريم لا اله الا الله العلي العظيم سبحان الله رب السماوات السبع ورب العرش العظيم الحمد لله رب العالمين
transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahul halimul karim, laa ilaaha illallaahul ‘aliyyul ‘azim, subhaanallaahi rabbis samawaatis sab’i wa rabbil ‘arshil ‘azim, alhamdu lillaahi rabbil ‘aalamin
translation: There is no true God but Allah the Most Patient, the Most Honorable. There is no true God but Allah the Most Exalted, the Most High. I am proclaiming the holiness of the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the glorious throne. All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
note: ‘Narrated from Ali bin Abi Talib (RA), will I not teach you some sentences which if you say you will be forgiven even though you are forgiven (He then told the above sentences)

name: Sayyidul Istighfar (Best way to ask forgiveness)
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِيْ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِيْ فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ رَبِّيْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِيْ وَاَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَاَنَا عَلٰى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ اَبُوْءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَاَبُوْءُ بِذَنْۢبِيْ فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ فَاِنَّهٗ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
clean: اللهم انت ربي لا اله الا انت خلقتني وانا عبدك وانا علي عهدك ووعدك ما استطعت اعوذ بك من شر ما صنعت ابوء لك بنعمتك علي وابوء بذنبي فاغفر لي فانه لا يغفر الذنوب الا انت
transliteration: Allaahumma anta rabbee laa ilaaha illaa anta, khalaqtanee wa-ana ‘abduka, wa-ana ‘alaa ‘ahdika wawa‘dika mas-tata‘tu, a‘oothu bika min sharri maa sana‘tu, aboo-o laka bini‘matika ‘alayya, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu laa yaghfirudh dhunooba illaa anta
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.

name: Repentance is mentioned in the Qur'an #1
content: Allah says:
uthmani: اِسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
indopak: اِسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
clean: استغفروا ربكم انه كان غفارا
translation: Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;

name: Repentance is mentioned in the Qur'an #2
content: Allah says:
uthmani: وَتُوبُوٓا إِلَى اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
indopak: وَتُوْبُوْ اِلٰى اللّٰهِ جَمِيْعًا اَيُّهَ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ
clean: وتوبو الي الله جميعا ايه المءمنون لعلكم تفلحون
translation: And turn to Allah in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.

name: Repentance is mentioned in the Qur'an #3
content: Allah says:
uthmani: يٰٓأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا تُوبُوٓا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا
indopak: يَا اَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا تُوْبُوْا اِلٰى اللّٰهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوْحًا
clean: يا ايها الذين امنوا توبوا الي الله توبه نصوحا
translation: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance.

name: Repentance is mentioned in the Qur'an #4
content: Allah says:
uthmani: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فٰحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوٓا أَنفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَن يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا عَلٰى مَا فَعَلُوا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
indopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ اِذَا فَعَلُوْا فٰحِشَةً اَوْ ظَلَمُوْا اَنْفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوْا لِذُنُوْبِهِمْ وَمَن يَّغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوْا عَلٰى مَا فَعَلُوْا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُوْنَ
clean: والذين اذا فعلوا فحشه او ظلموا انفسهم ذكروا الله فاستغفروا لذنوبهم ومن يغفر الذنوب الا الله ولم يصروا علي ما فعلوا وهم يعلمون
translation: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allah? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know.

name: Repentance is mentioned in the hadith #1
content: Narrated Abu Huraira: He said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say, 'By Allah! I pray and repent to Allah more than seventy times a day.

name: Repentance is mentioned in the hadith #2
content: Narrated Abu Burda: I heard Agar, the Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ), narrating a hadeeth quoting Ibn 'Umar. He said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, “People! Repent to Allah (turn to Him); I repent to him a hundred times a day.

name: Repentance is mentioned in the hadith #3
content: Narrated Agar Muzani (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Sometimes my heart goes astray, and I ask Allah for forgiveness a hundred times a day.

name: Statement of urgent need
content: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) narrated: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught us the Tashah-hud for Salat and the Tashah-hud for Al-Hajjah." He said: "The Tashah-hud for Salat is:
uthmani:
إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ وَنَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا، مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللَّهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمُونَ

يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالْأَرْحَامَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا 

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًۭا سَدِيدًا يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
indopak:
اِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلّٰهِ نَحْمَدُهٗ وَنَسْتَعِيْنُهٗ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهٗ وَنَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْ شُرُوْرِ اَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ اَعْمَالِنَا، مَنْ يَّهْدِ اللّٰهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهٗ  ـ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهٗ ـ  اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ ـ  يَا اَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهٖ وَلَا تَمُوْتُنَّ اِلَّا وَاَنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ 

يَا اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَكُم مِّنْ نَّفْسٍ وَّاحِدَةٍ ـ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيْرًا وَّنِسَاءً ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْ تَسَاءَلُوْنَ بِهٖ وَالْاَرْحَامَ ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيْبًا 

يَا اَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَقُوْلُوْا قَوْلًا سَدِيْدًا يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ اَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوْبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُّطِعِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيْمًا
clean: ان الحمد لله نحمده ونستعينه ونستغفره ونعوذ بالله من شرور انفسنا ومن سيءات اعمالنا من يهد الله فلا مضل له   ومن يضلل فلا هادي له   اشهد ان لا اله الا الله واشهد ان محمدا عبده ورسوله   يا ايها الذين امنوا اتقوا الله حق تقاته ولا تموتن الا وانتم مسلمون يا ايها الناس اتقوا ربكم الذي خلقكم من نفس واحده  وخلق منها زوجها وبث منهما رجالا كثيرا ونساء  واتقوا الله الذي تساءلون به والارحام  ان الله كان عليكم رقيبا يا ايها الذين امنوا اتقوا الله وقولوا قولا سديدا يصلح لكم اعمالكم ويغفر لكم ذنوبكم ومن يطع الله ورسوله فقد فاز فوزا عظيما
transliteration:
Innal-hamda lillaah nahmaduhu wa nasta‛eenuhu wa nastaghfiruhu, wa na‛oodhu billaahi min shuroori anfusinaa wa min sayyi’aati a‛maalinaa, man yahdih-illaahu fa laa mudilla lah, wa man yudlil fa laa haadiya lah, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha ill-Allaahu, wa ash-hadu anna muhammadan ‛abduhu wa rasooluh

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanut-taqullaaha ‘haqqa tuqaatihi walaa tamootunna illaa wa antum muslimoon

yaa ayyuhan-naasut-taqoo rabbakum-ul-ladhee khalaqakum min nafsin wa’hidatin, wa khalaqa minhaa zawjahaa, wa bath-tha minhumaa rijaalan katheeran wanisaa’-an, wat-taqullaahal-ladhee tasaa’aloona bihi wal ar’haam, inn-Allaaha kaana ‛alaykum raqeebaa

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanut-taqullaaha wa qooloo qawlan sadeeda, yusli’h lakum a‛maalakum wa yaghfir lakum dhunoobakum, wa man yuti‛illaaha wa rasoolahu faqad faaza fawz-an ‛azeemaa
translation:
Indeed all Praise is for Allah, we praise Him, we seek His help and we ask His forgiveness. We seek refuge with Allah from the evil of our own souls and from the evil of our actions. Whoever Allah guides will never be led astray,and whomever Allah leads astray, no one can guide. I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. (then reads the following verses)

O you who believe! Fear Allah as He should be feared, and die not except as Muslims; [1]

O Mankind! Fear your Lord, Who created you from a single person, and from him created his wife, and from them he created many men and women, and fear Allah through Whom you demand your mutual (rights). Surely, Allah is Ever Watchful over you; [2]

O you who believe! Fear Allah, and speak (always) the truth He will direct you to do righteous good deeds and will forgive you your sins. And whosoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has indeed achieved a great success. [3]
note: Then he would talk about his needs. [4]
reference:
[1] Surah Al Imran : 3:102
[2] Sura An-nisa : 4:1
[3] Suah  Al-Ahjab: 33:70-71
Sohih(albani) Timiji : 1105

name: Asking coolness of eyes from family and becoming example for the righteous
uthmani: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
indopak: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ اَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ اَعْيُنٍ وَّاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ اِمَامًا
clean: ربنا هب لنا من ازواجنا وذرياتنا قره اعين واجعلنا للمتقين اماما
translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

name: Congratulating the newlywed
uthmani: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
indopak: بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِيْ خَيْرٍ
clean: بارك الله لك وبارك عليك وجمع بينكما في خير
transliteration: BaarakAllaahu laka, wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jama'a baynakumaa fee khayr
translation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.
note: Abu Hurairah (RA) said, "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say this to congratulate the newlyweds."

name: Dua for accepting wife or husband
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
clean: اللهم اني اسالك خيرها وخير ما جبلتها عليه واعوذ بك من شرها ومن شر ما جبلتها عليه
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka khayrahaa wa khayra ma jabaltahaa 'alayhi wa 'A'oodhu bika min sharrihaa wa min sharri maa jabaltahaa 'alayhi
translation: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of her and the goodness upon which You have created her, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of her and from the evil upon which You have created her.

name: Dua for husband and wife praying together at weeding night
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) said that when a woman comes to her husband, the husband will stand for salat and his wife will also stand behind him and both of them will say after performing two rak'ats of salat.
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِي أَهْلِي، وَبَارِكْ لِأَهْلِي فِيَّ اَللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْهُمْ مِنِّي، وَارْزُقْنِي مِنْهُمْ، اَللَّهُمَّ اجْمَعْ بَيْنَنَا مَا جَمَعْتَ فِي خَيْرٍ، وفَرِّقْ بَيْنَنَا إِذَا فَرَّقْتَ فِي خَيْرٍ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِيْ فِيْ اَهْلِيْ، وَبَارِكْ لِاَهْلِيْ فِيَّ اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْهُمْ مِنِّيْ، وَارْزُقْنِيْ مِنْهُمْ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْمَعْ بَيْنَنَا مَا جَمَعْتَ فِيْ خَيْرٍ، وفَرِّقْ بَيْنَنَا اِذَا فَرَّقْتَ فِيْ خَيْرٍ
clean: اللهم بارك لي في اهلي وبارك لاهلي في اللهم ارزقهم مني وارزقني منهم اللهم اجمع بيننا ما جمعت في خير وفرق بيننا اذا فرقت في خير
transliteration: Allaahumma barik li fi ahli, wa barik li ahli fiyya. Allahumar-zuqhum minni, war zuqni minhum. Allahum-majma’ bainana ma jama’ta fi khairin. wa farriq bainana idha far-raqta fi khair
translation: Ya Allah! Give barakah for me in my family and give barakah to me for my family. Ya Allah! give provision to them from me and give provision to me from them. Ya Allah! collect all the good in between us which you collected and if you separate any good from us then separate it with good.

name: Before sexual intercourse
uthmani: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
indopak: بِاسْمِ اللّٰهِ اَللّٰهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
clean: باسم الله اللهم جنبنا الشيطان وجنب الشيطان ما رزقتنا
transliteration: Bismillaahi, Allaahumma jannibnash-Shaytaana, wa jannibish-Shaytaana maa razaqtanaa
translation: With the Name of Allah. O Allah, keep the I Devil away from us and keep the Devil away from that which You provide for us.
note: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, “If anyone says this before sexual intercourse is consummated, the Shaytaan will not harm him if a child is born to them.

name: Congratulations to the newborn
uthmani: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوْبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ.
indopak: بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوْبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ اَشُدَّهٗ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهٗ
clean: بارك الله لك في الموهوب لك وشكرت الواهب وبلغ اشده ورزقت بره
transliteration: BaarakAllahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-waahiba, wa balagha 'ashuddahu, wa ruziqta birrahu
translation: May Allah bless you with His gift to you, and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness.
reference: This is menioned as a saying of Hasan Al basri Rahimullah. See tuhfatul maodud fi Ibn Qaiiyum, Page. 20

name: Reply of the perents
uthmani: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
indopak: بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللّٰهُ خَيْرًا، وَرَزَقَكَ اللّٰهُ مِثْلَهٗ، وَاَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
clean: بارك الله لك وبارك عليك وجزاك الله خيرا ورزقك الله مثله واجزل ثوابك
transliteration: Baarakallahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jazaakAllahu khayran, wa razaqakAllahu mithlahu, wa 'ajzala thawaabaka
translation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly.
note: The above congratulations and answer are narrated from some of the Companions.
reference: An-Nawawi Al-Azkar Page. 349. Also see Sahih Azkar fil Nawawi, Salim al Hilali 2/713. For more details, read Az Zikr wa dua Wal Ilaj bir Ruqwa Page. 1/416

name: Prayers for forgiveness, loyalty and acceptance of deeds
uthmani: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ ﴿١٢٧﴾ رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ ﴿١٢٨﴾
indopak: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ ﴿١٢٧﴾ رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا اُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَاَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ ﴿١٢٨﴾
clean: ربنا تقبل منا  انك انت السميع العليم ١٢٧ ربنا واجعلنا مسلمين لك ومن ذريتنا امه مسلمه لك وارنا مناسكنا وتب علينا  انك انت التواب الرحيم ١٢٨
translation: (127) Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.(128) Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

name: Dua of child gain
uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
indopak: رَبِّ هَبْ لِىْ مِن لَّدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ اِنَّكَ سَمِيْعُ الدُّعَاءِ
clean: رب هب لي من لدنك ذريه طيبه  انك سميع الدعاء
translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

name: Dua for seeking forgiveness and establisher of prayer
uthmani: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ ﴿٤٠﴾ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ ﴿٤١﴾
indopak: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِىْ مُقِيْمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِىْ ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ ﴿٤٠﴾ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِىْ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ يَوْمَ يَقُوْمُ الْحِسَابُ ﴿٤١﴾
clean: رب اجعلني مقيم الصلاه ومن ذريتي  ربنا وتقبل دعاء ٤٠ ربنا اغفر لي ولوالدي وللمءمنين يوم يقوم الحساب ٤١
translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.(40) Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.(41)

name: Dua for parents
uthmani: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
indopak: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِىْ صَغِيْرًا
clean: رب ارحمهما كما ربياني صغيرا
translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.

name: Asking for correcting affairs and mercy
uthmani: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
indopak: رَبَّنَا اٰتِنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ اَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
clean: ربنا اتنا من لدنك رحمه وهيء لنا من امرنا رشدا
translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

name: Asking coolness of eyes from family and becoming example for the righteous
uthmani: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
indopak: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ اَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ اَعْيُنٍ وَّاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ اِمَامًا
clean: ربنا هب لنا من ازواجنا وذرياتنا قره اعين واجعلنا للمتقين اماما
translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

name: Manifestation of gratitude and supplication for acceptance of deeds
uthmani: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
indopak: رَبِّ اَوْزِعْنِىْ اَنْ اَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِىْ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلٰى وَالِدَيَّ وَاَنْ اَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَاَدْخِلْنِىْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِىْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ
clean: رب اوزعني ان اشكر نعمتك التي انعمت علي وعلي والدي وان اعمل صالحا ترضاه وادخلني برحمتك في عبادك الصالحين
translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants.

name: Dua of child gain
uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
indopak: رَبِّ هَبْ لِىْ مِنَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ
clean: رب هب لي من الصالحين
translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.

name: Manifestation of gratitude, supplication for acceptance of deeds and seeking righteous child
uthmani: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
indopak: رَبِّ اَوْزِعْنِىْ اَنْ اَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِىْ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلٰى وَالِدَيَّ وَاَنْ اَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَاَصْلِحْ لِىْ فِىْ ذُرِّيَّتِىْ ۖ اِنِّىْ تُبْتُ اِلَيْكَ وَاِنِّىْ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ
clean: رب اوزعني ان اشكر نعمتك التي انعمت علي وعلي والدي وان اعمل صالحا ترضاه واصلح لي في ذريتي  اني تبت اليك واني من المسلمين
translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.

name: Dua for family security and protection from shirk
uthmani: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَـٰذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِنًا وَاجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ
indopak: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هٰذَا الْبَلَدَ اٰمِنًا وَّاجْنُبْنِىْ وَبَنِيَّ اَن نَّعْبُدَ الْاَصْنَامَ
clean: رب اجعل هذا البلد امنا واجنبني وبني ان نعبد الاصنام
translation: My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.

name: Dua of Infertile Person
uthmani: وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِن وَرَائِي وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا ﴿٥﴾
indopak: وَاِنِّىْ خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِنْ وَّرَائِىْ وَكَانَتِ امْرَاَتِىْ عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِىْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا ﴿٥﴾
clean: واني خفت الموالي من وراءي وكانت امراتي عاقرا فهب لي من لدنك وليا ٥
translation: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir

name: Ask for paradise & protection from fire
uthmani: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ ﴿٧﴾ رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ﴿٨﴾ وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ ﴿٩﴾
indopak: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَّعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِيْنَ تَابُوْا وَاتَّبَعُوْا سَبِيْلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِ ﴿٧﴾ رَبَّنَا وَاَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنِ ࣘ  الَّتِىْ وَعَدْتَّهُمْ وَمَنْ صَلَحَ مِنْ اٰبَائِهِمْ وَاَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ ۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ ﴿٨﴾ وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ وَمَنْ تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ ۚ وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ ﴿٩﴾
clean: ربنا وسعت كل شيء رحمه وعلما فاغفر للذين تابوا واتبعوا سبيلك وقهم عذاب الجحيم ٧ ربنا وادخلهم جنات عدن   التي وعدتهم ومن صلح من اباءهم وازواجهم وذرياتهم  انك انت العزيز الحكيم ٨ وقهم السيءات  ومن تق السيءات يومءذ فقد رحمته  وذلك هو الفوز العظيم ٩
translation: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.(7) Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.(8) And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment." (9)

name: Dua for parents
uthmani: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا
indopak: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِىْ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَّلِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِيْنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًا
clean: رب اغفر لي ولوالدي ولمن دخل بيتي مءمنا وللمءمنين والمءمنات ولا تزد الظالمين الا تبارا
translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."

name: Dua for increasing ibaadah and provision
content: Ibrahim (AS) prayed the following Dua for his children and family:
uthmani: رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ فَاجْعَلْ أَفْئِدَةً مِنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ وَارْزُقْهُمْ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
indopak: رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيْمُوْا الصَّلَاةَ فَاجْعَلْ اَفْئِدَةً مِّنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِيْ اِلَيْهِمْ وَارْزُقْهُمْ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُوْنَ
clean: ربنا ليقيموا الصلاه فاجعل افءده من الناس تهوي اليهم وارزقهم من الثمرات لعلهم يشكرون
translation: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.

name: Dua for settling debt #1
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْ بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْ بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَاَغْنِنِيْ بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
clean: اللهم اكفني بحلالك عن حرامك واغنني بفضلك عمن سواك
transliteration: Allaahummak-finee bihalaalika 'an haraamika wa 'aghninee bifadhlika 'amman siwaak
translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.
note: Ali (RA) narrated: That a Mukatib came to him and said: “Indeed I am not capable of my Kitabah so aid me.” He said: “Should I not teach you words that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught me? If you had a debt upon you similar to the mountain of Sir, Allah would fulfill it for you. He said: (The dua is mentioned above)

name: Dua for settling debt #2
content: Prophet (ﷺ) used to say these Dua more and more:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من الهم والحزن والعجز والكسل والبخل والجبن وضلع الدين وغلبه الرجال
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'A'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazani, wal'ajzi wal-kasali, wal-bukhli wal-jubni, wa dhala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and from being overpowered by men (i.e. other people).

name: Dua for settling debt #3
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ مٰلِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتَنْزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشَاءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ رَحْمَانُ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَرَحِيْمَهُمَا تُعْطِيْهِمَا مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتَمْنَعُ مِنْهُمَا مَنْ تَشَاءُ ارْحَمْنِيْ رَحْمَةً تُغْنِيْنِيْ بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةِ مَنْ سِوَاكَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ مٰلِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتَنْزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشَاءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ رَحْمَانُ الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ وَرَحِيْمَهُمَا تُعْطِيْهِمَا مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتَمْنَعُ مِنْهُمَا مَنْ تَشَاءُ اِرْحَمْنِيْ رَحْمَةً تُغْنِيْنِيْ بِهَا عَنْ رَّحْمَةِ مَنْ سِوَاكَ
clean: اللهم ملك الملك تءتي الملك من تشاء وتنزع الملك ممن تشاء وتعز من تشاء وتذل من تشاء بيدك الخير انك علي كل شيء قدير رحمان الدنيا والاخره ورحيمهما تعطيهما من تشاء وتمنع منهما من تشاء ارحمني رحمه تغنيني بها عن رحمه من سواك
transliteration: Allaahumma maalik-al-mulki tu’til-mulka man tashaa’u, wa tanzi‛-ul-mulka mimman tashaa’u, wa tu‛izzu man tashaa’u wa tudhillu man tashaa’u, bi yadik-al-khayru innaka ‛alaa kulli shay’in qadeer, ra'hmaanud-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa ra'heemahumaa, tu‛teehimaa man tashaa’u, wa tamna‛u minhumaa man tashaa’-ur'hamnee ra'hmatan tughneenee bihaa ‛an ra'hmati man siwaak
translation: O Allah, Master (and owner) of the Dominion (or Kingdom), You give the dominion to whom You will, and You take the dominion from whom You will, and You exalt whom You will, and You humiliate whom You will. In Your Hand is all goodness. Verily, You are Able to do all things. The Beneficent and the Merciful of this world and the hereafter, You bestow them on whomever You will and withhold them from whomever You will. Have mercy on me, (such) Mercy that would not make me in need of the mercy of others (than you).
note: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to Mu'adh (RA), 'If you pray this Dua, Allah will repay you even if you have a mountain of debt.

name: Dua for settling debt #4
content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite this supplication in the prayer:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْـيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ. اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيْحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ. اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من عذاب القبر واعوذ بك من فتنه المسيح الدجال واعوذ بك من فتنه المحيا والممات اللهم اني اعوذ بك من الماثم والمغرم
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabil-qabr, wa 'a'oodhu bika min fitnatil-maseehid-dajjaal, wa 'a'oodhu bika min fitnatil-mahyaa wal-mamaat. Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oodhu bika minal-ma'thami wal-maghram
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of the False Messiah, and I seek refuge in You from the trials of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.
note: One asks him (the Prophet [ﷺ]), "Why do you seek so much refuge (from Allah) in debt?" In reply, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a person is in debt, he lies when he speaks and breaks his promise.

name: Dua for settling debt #5
content: Aishah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to supplicate with these words:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ النَّارِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَشَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْغِنَى، وَشَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْفَقْرِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، اَللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ قَلْبِي بِمَاءِ الثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّ قَلْبِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ. اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ النَّارِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَشَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْغِنٰى، وَشَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْفَقْرِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيْحِ الدَّجَّالِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْسِلْ قَلْبِيْ بِمَاءِ الثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّ قَلْبِيْ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْاَبْيَضَ مِنْ الدَّنَسِ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ. اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْكَسَلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من فتنه النار وعذاب النار وفتنه القبر وعذاب القبر وشر فتنه الغني وشر فتنه الفقر اللهم اني اعوذ بك من فتنه المسيح الدجال اللهم اغسل قلبي بماء الثلج والبرد ونق قلبي من الخطايا كما نقيت الثوب الابيض من الدنس وباعد بيني وبين خطاياي كما باعدت بين المشرق والمغرب اللهم اني اعوذ بك من الكسل والهرم والماثم والمغرم
transliteration: Allaahumma inni a`udhu bika min fitnatin-nar, wa `adhabin-nar, wa fitnatil-qabr, wa `adhabil-qabr, wa sharri fitnatil-ghina, wa sharri fitnatil-faqr, Allaahumma inni a`udhu bika min fitnatil- masihid-dajjal. Allaahummaghsil qalbi bi-ma’ith-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqi qalbi minal-khataaya kamaa naqqaitath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa ba`id baini wa baina khaatayaaya kamaa ba`adta bainal-mashriqi wal maghrib, Allaahumma inni a`udhu bika min al-kasali wal-harami wal-ma’thami wal-maghram
translation: O Allah, indeed, I seek refuge in You from the trial of the Fire, and the punishment of the Fire, and the punishment of the grave, and the trial of the grave, and from the evil of the trial of the grave, and from the evil of the trials of wealth, and from the evils of the trials of poverty, and from the evil of the trial of the false Masih. O Allah, wash my sins with water of ice and hail, and cleanse my heart of sins, as You cleansed a white garment of filth, and distance me and my sins as You distanced between the east and the west. O Allah, indeed, I seek refuge in You from laziness, senility, sin and debt.

name: Dua for settling debt #6
content: Narrated Abu Huraira (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to instruct us when we go to sleep we should say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اِقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْاَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوٰى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْاِنْجِيْلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ، اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ اَنْتَ اٰخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهٖ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الْاَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَاَنْتَ الْاٰخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَاَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَاَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُوْنَكَ شَيْءٌ، اِقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَاَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
clean: اللهم رب السماوات السبع ورب الارض ورب العرش العظيم ربنا ورب كل شيء فالق الحب والنوي ومنزل التوراه والانجيل والفرقان اعوذ بك من شر كل شيء انت اخذ بناصيته اللهم انت الاول فليس قبلك شيء وانت الاخر فليس بعدك شيء وانت الظاهر فليس فوقك شيء وانت الباطن فليس دونك شيء اقض عنا الدين واغننا من الفقر
transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i, wa Rabbal-Ardi, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, Rabbanaa wa Rabba kulli shay'in, faaliqal-habbi wannawaa, wa munzilat-Tawraati wal-'Injeeli, wal-Furqaan, 'A'oodhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in 'Anta 'aakhithun binaasiyatihi. Allaahumma 'Antal-'Awwalu falaysa qablaka shay'un, wa 'Antal-'Aakhiru falaysa ba'daka shay'un, wa 'Antadh-Dhaahiru falaysa fawqaka shay'un, wa 'Antal-Baatinu falaysa doonaka shay'un, iqdhi 'annad-dayna wa 'aghninaa minal-faqr
translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Towraat, the Injeel and the Furqaan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock. O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You. You are ath-Thaahir so there is nothing above You and You are al-Baatin so there is nothing closer than You. Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.

name: Dua for settling debt #7
content: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah ibn' Amr (RA): That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الْعَدُوِّ وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الْعَدُوِّ وَشَمَاتَةِ الْاَعْدَاءِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من غلبه الدين وغلبه العدو وشماته الاعداء
transliteration: Allaahumma inni A‛oodhu bika min ghalabatid-daini, wa ghalabatil-'aduwwi, wa shamaatatil-a'da'i
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from being overwhelmed with debt, from being overpowered by the enemy and from the enemy rejoicing over my misfortunes.

name: Dua at the time of loan repayment
content: It was narrated Abdullah bin Abi Rabi'ah (RA): The Prophet (ﷺ) borrowed forty thousand from me, when some wealth came to him, he then paid me back and said:
uthmani: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالْأَدَاءُ
indopak: بارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ فِيْ اَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، اِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالْاَدَاءُ
clean: بارك الله لك في اهلك ومالك انما جزاء السلف الحمد والاداء
transliteration: BaarakAllahu laka fee 'ahlika wa maalika, 'innamaa jazaa'us-salafil-hamdu wal' adaa'u
translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed).

name: Dua in a state of Anxiety and sorrow #1
uthmani: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، الْعَظِيْمُ الْحَلِيْمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيْمِ
indopak: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ، اَلْعَظِيْمُ الْحَلِيْمُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ، رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ، رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الْاَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيْمِ
clean: لا اله الا الله العظيم الحليم لا اله الا الله رب العرش العظيم لا اله الا الله رب السماوات ورب الارض ورب العرش الكريم
transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllaahul-'Adheemul-Haleem, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllaahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllaahu Rabbus-samaawaati wa Rabbul-'ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Kareem
translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
note:
The Prophet (ﷺ) used to invoke Allah at the time of distress, saying, (the dua is mentioned above). [1]

Ali (RA) said, The Messenger of Allah taught me this above mentioned dua in the state of anxiety and distress. [2]
reference:
[1] Bukhari 6346
[2] Sahih Ibn Hibban 3/147, Musnad Ahmad 194

name: Dua in a state of Anxiety and sorrow #1
uthmani: اَللَّهُ اَللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَللّٰهُ رَبِّيْ لَا اُشْرِكُ بِهٖ شَيْئًا
clean: الله الله ربي لا اشرك به شيءا
transliteration: Allahu Allahu Rabbee laa 'ushriku bihi shay'an.
translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.
note: Narrated Asma' daughter of Umays (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: May I not teach you phrases which you utter in distress? These are: (The dua is mentioned avobe)

name: When in distress #1
content: Narrated Abdullah Ibn Masood (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said, "If a servant is faced with any anxiety or distress, then say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُــــلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ عَبْدُكَ، وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، وَابْنُ اَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِيْ بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، اَسْاَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهٖ نَفْسَكَ، اَوْ اَنْزَلْتَهٗ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ، اَوْ عَلَّمْتَهٗ اَحَدًا  مِّنْ خَلْقِكَ، اَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهٖ فِيْ عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، اَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْاٰنَ رَبِيْعَ قَلْبِيْ، وَنُوْرَ صَدْرِيْ، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِيْ، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّيْ
clean: اللهم اني عبدك وابن عبدك وابن امتك ناصيتي بيدك ماض في حكمك عدل في قضاءك اسالك بكل اسم هو لك سميت به نفسك او انزلته في كتابك او علمته احدا  من خلقك او استاثرت به في علم الغيب عندك ان تجعل القران ربيع قلبي ونور صدري وجلاء حزني وذهاب همي
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'abduka, wabnu 'abdika, wabnu 'amatika, naasiyatee biyadika, maadhin fiyya hukmuka, 'adlun fiyya qadhaa'uka, 'as'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka, sammayta bihi nafsaka, 'aw 'anzaltahu fee kitaabika, 'aw 'allamtahu 'ahadan min khalqika, 'awista'tharta bihi fee 'ilmil-ghaybi 'indaka, 'an taj'alal-Qur'aana rabee'a qalbee, wa noora sadree, wa jalaa'a huznee, wa thahaaba hammee
translation: O Allah, I am Your slave and the son of Your male slave and the son of your female slave. My forehead is in Your Hand (i.e. you have control over me). Your Judgment upon me is assured and Your Decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every Name that You have named Yourself with, revealed in Your Book, taught any one of Your creation or kept unto Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen that is with You, to make the Qur'an the spring of my heart, and the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness and the reliever of my distress.
note: Allah will surely remove his worries and troubles and replace them with joy. ”It was asked, O Messenger of Allah! Shall we not learn it? ' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, “Of course! Anyone who hears this should memorize it.”

name: When in distress #2
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من الهم والحزن والعجز والكسل والبخل والجبن وضلع الدين وغلبه الرجال
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'A'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazani, wal'ajzi wal-kasali, wal-bukhli wal-jubni, wa dhala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i.e. others).

name: When in distress #3
content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, “The supplication of the anxious person is -
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ اَرْجُوْ، فَلَا تَكِلْنِيْ اِلٰى نَفْسِيْ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَاَصْلِحْ لِيْ شَأْنِيْ كُلَّهٗ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
clean: اللهم رحمتك ارجو فلا تكلني الي نفسي طرفه عين واصلح لي شاني كله لا اله الا انت
transliteration: Allaahumma rahmataka 'arjoo falaa takilnee 'ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayen, wa 'aslih lee sha'nee kullahu, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta
translation: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment). Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.
note: Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this supplication increasingly.

name: When in distress #4
content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The supplication of Dhun-Nun (Prophet Yunus) when he supplicated, while in the belly of the whale was:
uthmani: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
indopak: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اِنِّيْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ
clean: لا اله الا انت سبحانك اني كنت من الظالمين
transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta subhaanaka 'innee kuntu minadh-dhaalimeen
translation: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.
note: So indeed, no Muslim man supplicates with it for anything, ever, except Allah responds to him. [1]

name: Upon seeing someone in trial or tribulation
content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A person who sees a person in danger, then says:
uthmani: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
indopak: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ عَافَانِيْ مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهٖ، وَفَضَّلَنِيْ عَلٰى كَثِيْرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيْلًا
clean: الحمد لله الذي عافاني مما ابتلاك به وفضلني علي كثير ممن خلق تفضيلا
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee 'aafaanee mimmab-talaaka bihi wa fadhdhalanee 'alaa katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdheela
translation: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created.
note: That danger will not touch him.

name: When one's affairs have become difficult
uthmani: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيْثُ
indopak: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ
clean: يا حي يا قيوم  برحمتك استغيث
transliteration: Ya ‘hayyi-u ya qayyumu bira’hmatika astagith
translation: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance.
note: Whenever a matter would distress him, the Prophet (ﷺ) would say (above dua)

name: Dua for hopelessness
uthmani: قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
indopak: قَدَرُ اللّٰهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
clean: قدر الله وما شاء فعل
transliteration: Qadarullaahi wa maa shaa'a fa'al
translation: It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills.
note: Abu Huraira (RA) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A strong believer is better and is more lovable to Allah than a weak believer, and there is good in everyone, (but) cherish that which gives you benefit (in the Hereafter) and seek help from Allah and do not lose heart, and if anything (in the form of trouble) comes to you, don't say: If I had not done that, it would not have happened so and so, but say: (The dua is mentioned above) and your" if" opens the (gate) for the Satan.

name: When one's affairs have become difficult
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ اِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَاَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ اِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
clean: اللهم لا سهل الا ما جعلته سهلا وانت تجعل الحزن اذا شءت سهلا
transliteration: Allaahumma laa sahlaa illaa maa ja'altahu sahlaa, wa Anta taj'alul-hazna 'idhaa shi'ta sahlaa
translation: O Allah, there is no ease other than what You make easy. If You want You ease sorrow.

name: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority #1
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِيْ نُحُوْرِهِمْ وَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُوْرِهِمْ
clean: اللهم انا نجعلك في نحورهم ونعوذ بك من شرورهم
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innaa naj'aluka fee nuhoorihim wa nA'oodhu bika min shuroorihim
translation: O Allah, we ask You to restrain them by their necks and we seek refuge in You from their evil.

name: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority #২
content: Prophet (ﷺ) said, If anyone fears to encounter an enemy or those of authority, then he should say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ كُنْ لِي جَارًا مِنْ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلَائِقِكَ (وَمِنْ شَرِّ خَلْقِكَ كُلِّهِمْ جَمِيْعًا) أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى عَزَّ جَارُكَ وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَلَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ كُنْ لِّيْ جَارًا مِّنْ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ، وَاَحْزَابِهٖ مِنْ خَلَائِقِكَ (وَمِنْ شَرِّ خَلْقِكَ كُلِّهِمْ جَمِيْعًا) اَنْ يَّفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ اَحَدٌ مِّنْهُمْ اَوْ يَطْغٰى عَزَّ جَارُكَ وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَلَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
clean: اللهم رب السماوات السبع ورب العرش العظيم كن لي جارا من فلان بن فلان واحزابه من خلاءقك ومن شر خلقك كلهم جميعا ان يفرط علي احد منهم او يطغي عز جارك وجل ثناءك ولا اله الا انت
transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbas-samawaatis-sab'i, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, kun lee jaaran min [here you mention the person's name], wa 'ahzaabihi min khalaa'iqika, (wa min sharri khalqika kullihim jami'an) 'an yafruta 'alayya 'ahadun minhum 'aw yatghaa, 'azza jaaruka, wajalla thanaa'uka, wa laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta
translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is Your patronage and glorious are Your praises. There is none worthy of worship but You.
note: Narrated from Abdullah Ibn Masood (RA) and Abdullah Ibn Abbas (RA), they said: If anyone fears harm from any ruler, administrator or powerful person, he should recite this dua.

name: Dua of self-defense if one fears harm from anyone
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
clean: اللهم اكفنيهم بما شءت
transliteration: Allaahummak-fineehim bimaa shi'ta
translation: O Allah, suffice (i.e. protect) me against them however You wish.

name: Dua for one afflicted by a calamity
uthmani: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اَللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِيْ فِي مُصِيْبَتِيْ وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
indopak: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَاِنَّا اِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ أْجُرْنِيْ فِيْ مُصِيْبَتِيْ وَاَخْلِفْ لِيْ خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا
clean: انا لله وانا اليه راجعون اللهم اجرني في مصيبتي واخلف لي خيرا منها
transliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa 'innaa 'ilayhi raaji'oon, Allaahumma'-jurni fee museebatee wa 'akhlif lee khayran minhaa
translation: We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better.
note: Umm Salama (RA) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If any Muslim who suffers some calamity says, what Allah has commanded him," We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better. When Abu Salama died Umm Salama said: What Muslim is better than Abu Salama whose family was the first to emigrate to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I then said the words, and Allah gave me God's Messenger (ﷺ) in exchange.

name: Dua upon seeing a person who has been afflicted by an ilness or disability
uthmani: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِيْ مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِيْ عَلَى كَثِيْرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيْلًا
indopak: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ عَافَانِيْ مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهٖ وَفَضَّلَنِيْ عَلٰى كَثِيْرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيْلًا
clean: الحمد لله الذي عافاني مما ابتلاك به وفضلني علي كثير ممن خلق تفضيلا
transliteration: Al-hamdu lil-laahil-ladhee ‘aafaanee mim-mab-ta-laaka bihi, wa fad-dala-nee ‛alaa kathee-rin mim-man khalaqa taf-deelaa
translation: Praise be to Allah who had saved me from what He had afflicted you with, and for honouring me over many of his creations.
note: Umar (RA) narrated that: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Whoever sees a person afflicted and say: (The dua is mentioned above) then he shall be saved from that affliction for as long as he lives.” Grandson of Husain (RA), Muhammad al-Bakir said, dua should be uttered silently without hearing the afflicted person.

name: Protection of Insect stings
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
clean: اعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من شر ما خلق
transliteration: A‛oodhu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq
translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
note: Abu Huraira (RA) reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:" Allah's Messenger, I was stung by a scorpion during the night. Thereupon he said: Had you recited these words in the evening:" I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of what He created," it would not have done any harm to you."

name: Prayer for victory over enemies
uthmani: يَا حَيُّ، يَا قَيُّوْمُ
indopak: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ
clean: يا حي يا قيوم
transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom
translation: O Ever Living One, O Eternal One.
note:
Ali (RA) said: ”In the day of Badr war, after fighting for some while I was rushing to come to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to see what he was doing. I saw him in a state of prostration and only saying these words : ya ‘hayyu ya qayyum (O Ever Living One, O Eternal One) and didn’t increase over that. Then again I went to the war. After some time I returned to him. Again I saw him in a state of prostration and only saying those same words.Then again I went to the war. After some time  I returned to him and saw him in a state of prostration and only saying those same words. Then Allah granted him (ﷺ) victory.

We can see in this hadith how to make dua by dhikr. This type of dua brings best result.

name: Anxiety and Sorrow #1
content: Ibn 'Abbas (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say these words in times of danger or hardship:
uthmani: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، الْعَظِيْمُ الْحَلِيْمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
indopak: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ، اَلْعَظِيْمُ الْحَلِيْمُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ، رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ، رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الْاَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيْمِ
clean: لا اله الا الله العظيم الحليم لا اله الا الله رب العرش العظيم لا اله الا الله رب السماوات ورب الارض ورب العرش الكريم
transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllaahul-'Adheemul-Haleem, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllaahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllaahu Rabbus-samaawaati wa Rabbul-'ardhi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Kareem
translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

name: Anxiety and Sorrow #2
uthmani: اَللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
indopak: اَللّٰهُ رَبِّيْ لَا اُشْرِكُ بِهٖ شَيْئًا
clean: الله ربي لا اشرك به شيءا
transliteration: Allahu Rabbee laa 'ushriku bihi shay'an
translation: Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.
note: Ayesha (RA) said, "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to gather all his family together and say: If any of you are ever in trouble or in danger, say this."

name: Anxiety and Sorrow #3
content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to say during the battle:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ عَضُدِيْ، وَاَنْتَ نَصِيْرِيْ، بِكَ اَحُوْلُ وَبِكَ اَصُوْلُ، وَبِكَ اُقَاتِلُ
clean: اللهم انت عضدي وانت نصيري بك احول وبك اصول وبك اقاتل
transliteration: Allaahumma 'Anta 'adhudee, wa 'Anta naseeree, bika 'a'hoolu, wa bika 'asoolu, wa bika 'uqaatilu
translation: O Allah, You are my strength and You are my support. For Your sake I go forth and for Your sake I advance and for Your sake I fight.

name: Anxiety and Sorrow #4
uthmani: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
indopak: حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ
clean: حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل
transliteration: HasbunAllahu wa ni'amal-wakeel
translation: Allah is sufficient for me, and how fine a trustee (He is).
note: This dua was recited by Ibrahim (As) when he was thrown into the fire. And Muhammad (ﷺ) recited this prayer when the people said to him, "The people are united against you!"

name: Dua against the oppression
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اَللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعًا، اَللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلَانٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ، اَللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَارًا مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ، اَللّٰهُ اَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيْعًا، اَللّٰهُ اَعَزُّ مِمَّا اَخَافُ وَاَحْذَرُ، اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ، اَلْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ اَنْ يَّقَعْنَ عَلَى الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهٖ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلَانٍ، وَجُنُوْدِهٖ وَاَتْبَاعِهٖ وَاَشْيَاعِهٖ، مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ كُنْ لِّيْ جَارًا مِّنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلَا اِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
clean: الله اكبر الله اعز من خلقه جميعا الله اعز مما اخاف واحذر اعوذ بالله الذي لا اله الا هو الممسك السماوات السبع ان يقعن علي الارض الا باذنه من شر عبدك فلان وجنوده واتباعه واشياعه من الجن والانس اللهم كن لي جارا من شرهم جل ثناءك وعز جارك وتبارك اسمك ولا اله غيرك
transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar, Allahu 'a'azzu min khalqihi jamee'an, Allahu 'a'azzu mimmaa 'akhaafu wa 'ahdharu, 'A'oodhu billaahil-ladhee laa 'ilaaha 'illaa Huwa almumsikis-samaawaatis-sab'i 'an yaqa'na 'alal-'ardhi 'illaa bi'idhnihi, min sharri 'abdika (name of the person), wa junoodihi wa 'atbaa'ihi wa 'ashyaa'ihi, minal-jinni wal'insi, Allaahumma kun lee jaaran min sharrihim, jalla thanaa'uka wa 'azza jaaruka, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa laa 'ilaaha ghayruk
translation: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what I fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the Seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. (I seek refuge in You Allah) from the evil of Your slave (say the person's name), and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious are Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You.
note: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas (RA) : When you meet an influential person who is causing terror and you fear that he will attack you, you will say three times: (The dua is mentioned above)

name: Dua made against enemies
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اِهْزِمِ الْأَحْزَابَ، اَللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيْعَ الْحِسَابِ، اَهْزِمِ الْاَحْزَابَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
clean: اللهم منزل الكتاب سريع الحساب اهزم الاحزاب اللهم اهزمهم وزلزلهم
transliteration: Allaahumma munzilal-kitaabi, saree'al-hisaabi, ihzimil-'ahzaaba, Allaahummah zimhum wa zalzilhum
translation: Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them.

name: Dua against the oppressor
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنِي بِسَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَاجْعَلْهُمَا الْوَارِثَ مِنِّي، وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنِي وَخُذْ مِنْهُ بِثَأْرِي
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَتِّعْنِيْ بِسَمْعِيْ وَبَصَرِيْ وَاجْعَلْهُمَا الْوَارِثَ مِنِّيْ، وَانْصُرْنِيْ عَلٰى مَنْ ظَلَمَنِيْ وَخُذْ مِنْهُ بِثَأْرِيْ
clean: اللهم متعني بسمعي وبصري واجعلهما الوارث مني وانصرني علي من ظلمني وخذ منه بثاري
transliteration: Allaahumma matti‛ni bi sam‛i wa basari waj-‛alhumal-waaritha minni, wan-surni ‛alaa man zalamani, wa khudh minhu bi tha’ri
translation: O Allah, grant me enjoyment of my hearing and sight, and keep them healthy and sound until the day I die, and aid me against those who oppress me, and avenge me from them.

name: Dua for not placing among wrongdoers
uthmani: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
indopak: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِيْنَ
clean: ربنا لا تجعلنا مع القوم الظالمين
translation: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.

name: Dua for Debt settlement #1
content: Even if the burden of debt is like a mountain, (if this dua is recited) Allah will forgive the debt:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْ بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَاَغْنِنِيْ بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
clean: اللهم اكفني بحلالك عن حرامك واغنني بفضلك عمن سواك
transliteration: Allaahummak-finee bi 'halaalika ‛an 'haraamika, wa aghninee bi fadlika ‛amman siwaak
translation: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace of the need for others.

name: Dua for Debt settlement #2
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) said:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من الهم والحزن والعجز والكسل والبخل والجبن وضلع الدين وغلبه الرجال
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'A'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal hazani, wal'ajzi wal kasali, wal bukhli wal jubni, wa dhala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men.

name: Placing children under Allah's protection
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) sought salvation for Hasan-Hussein (grandchildren) in this way:
uthmani: أُعِيْذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَّهَامَّةٍ وَّمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
indopak: اُعِيْذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَّهَامَّةٍ وَّمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَّامَّةٍ
clean: اعيذكما بكلمات الله التامه من كل شيطان وهامه ومن كل عين لامه
transliteration: U'eethukumaa bikalimaatil-laahit-taammati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah, wa min kulli 'aynin laammah
translation: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.

name: In time of Danger
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) In times of danger, he used to say -
uthmani: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّى كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ
indopak: لَا اِلٰه اِلَّا اَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اِنِّىْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ
clean: لا اله الا انت سبحانك اني كنت من الظالمين
transliteration: Laa Ilaaha Illaaa Anta Subh’aanaka Innee Kuntu Minaz” Z’aalimeen
translation: None has the right to be worshipped but You (O Allah), Glorified (and Exalted) are You. Truly, I have been of the wrong-doers.

name: When Panicked
content: Narrated Zainab bint Jahsh (RA): That the Prophet (ﷺ) once came to her in a state of fear and said:
uthmani: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
indopak: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ
clean: لا اله الا الله
transliteration: Laa Ilaaha Illaallah
translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah.
note: Woe unto the Arabs from a danger that has come near. An opening has been made in the wall of Gog and Magog like this," making a circle with his thumb and index finger. Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we be destroyed even though there are pious persons among us?" He said, "Yes, when the evil person will increase."

name: For one you have insulted
content: Narrated by Abu Huraira (RA), He heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهٗ فَاجْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ لَهٗ قُرْبَةً اِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
clean: اللهم فايما مءمن سببته فاجعل ذلك له قربه اليك يوم القيامه
transliteration: Allaahumma fa'ayyumaa mu'minin sababtuhu faj'al dhaalika lahu qurbatan 'ilayka yawmal-qiyaamah
translation: O Allah, whomever of the believers I have abused, make it a means of gaining nearness to you on the Day of Resurrection.

name: Etiquette of praising a fellow Muslim
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever amongst you has to praise his brother should say:
uthmani: أَحْسِبُ فُلَانًا وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ وَلَا أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَدًا أَحْسِبُهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا
indopak: اَحْسِبُ فُلَانًا وَاللّٰهُ حَسِيْبُهٗ وَلَا اُزَكِّيْ عَلَى اللّٰهِ اَحَدًا اَحْسِبُهٗ كَذَا وَكَذَا
clean: احسب فلانا والله حسيبه ولا ازكي علي الله احدا احسبه كذا وكذا
transliteration: Ahsibu fulaanan wAllaahu haseebuhu wa laa 'uzakkee 'alAllaahi 'ahadan ahsibuhu kadha wa kadha
translation: I think that he is so and so, and Allah knows exactly the truth, and I do not confirm anybody's good conduct before Allah, but I think him so and so.
note: It is to be said when you must ensure you have knowledge that the certain characteristic is present in that person.

name: For the one that have been praised
content: One of Companions of The Prophet (ﷺ) had a characteristic that if he was praised, he would say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِيْ بِمَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ، وَاجْعَلْنِيْ خَيْرًا مِّمَّا يَظُّنُّوْنَ
clean: اللهم لا تءاخذني بما يقولون واغفر لي ما لا يعلمون واجعلني خيرا مما يظنون
transliteration: Allaahumma laa tu'aakhidhnee bimaa yaqooloon, waghfir lee maa laa ya'lamoon waj'alnee khayram-mimmaa yadhunnoon
translation: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of and make me better than they imagine.

name: For the one who asks Allah to forgive your sins
content: Abdullah bin Sarjis (RA) said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "O Messenger of Allah! -
uthmani: غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ
indopak: غَفَرَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ
clean: غفر الله لك
transliteration: Ghafar-Allahu lak
translation: May Allah forgive you.

name: If someone does a good job for you
content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whoever some good was done to him, and he says:
uthmani: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
indopak: جَزَاكَ اللّٰهُ خَيْرًا
clean: جزاك الله خيرا
transliteration: JazaakAllahu khayran
translation: May Allah reward you with good.
note: Then he has done the most that he can of praise.

name: Protection from the Dajjal
content: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone learns by heart the first ten verses of the Surah al-Kahf, he will be protected from the Dajjal.

name: Seeking refuge from four things
content: Abu Hurairah (RA) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: When one of you finishes the last tashahhud, he should seek refuge in Allah from four things: the punishment in Hell, the punishment in the grave, the trail of life and death, and the evil of Antichrist.

Abu Dawud: 5125", "audio": null, "groups": null, "languageId": "en"}]
name: If anyone likes you for the sake of Allah
content: If a Muslim brother want to tell him that he loves him, he should say:
uthmani: أُحِبُّكَ فِي اللَّهِ
indopak: اُحِبُّكَ فِيْ اللّٰهِ
clean: احبك في الله
transliteration: U'hibbuka fill-aah
translation: I love you for the sake of Allah.

name: To one who has offered you some of his wealth
content: When Saad (RA) wanted to give half of his family and wealth, Abdur Rahman (RA) said -
uthmani: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
indopak: بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ فِيْ اَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
clean: بارك الله لك في اهلك ومالك
transliteration: BaarakAllahu laka fee 'ahlika wa maalika
translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your property.
note: `Abdur-Rahman (RA) then said, "Where is your market?" So they showed him the Qainuqa' market. (He went there and) returned with a profit in the form of dried yogurt and butter. He continued going (to the market) till one day he came, bearing the traces of yellow scent. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What is this (scent)?" He replied, "I got married." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "How much Mahr did you give her?" He replied, "I gave her a datestone of gold or a gold piece equal to the weight of a date-stone." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Arrange a marriage banquet even with a sheep.

name: To the debtor when his debt is settled
content: When repaying the loan, the Prophet (ﷺ) said:
uthmani: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالْأَدَاءُ
indopak: بارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ فِىْ اَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، اِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالْاَدَاءُ
clean: بارك الله لك في اهلك ومالك انما جزاء السلف الحمد والاداء
transliteration: BaarakAllahu laka fee 'ahlika wa maalika, 'innamaa jazaa'us-salafil-hamdu wal'adaa'
translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed).
