name: Dua of the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of the battle of Badr
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِزْ لِي مَا وَعَدْتَنِي اَللَّهُمَّ آتِ مَا وَعَدْتَنِي اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ تُهْلِكْ هَذِهِ الْعِصَابَةَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ لَا تُعْبَدُ فِي الْأَرْضِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْجِزْ لِيْ مَا وَعَدْتَّنِيْ اَللّٰهُمَّ اٰتِ مَا وَعَدْتَّنِيْ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ تُهْلِكْ هٰذِهِ الْعِصَابَةَ مِنْ اَهْلِ الْاِسْلَامِ لَا تُعْبَدُ فِيْ الْاَرْضِ
clean: اللهم انجز لي ما وعدتني اللهم ات ما وعدتني اللهم ان تهلك هذه العصابه من اهل الاسلام لا تعبد في الارض
transliteration: Allaahumma anjiz li ma wa ‘adtani, Allaahumma aati ma wa ‘adtani, Allaahumma in tuhlik hadhi-hil 'ishabata min ahlil Islaami, la tu'badu fil ardi
translation: O Allah! Fulfill what You promised for me. [O Allah! Bring about what You promised for me] O Allah! If you destroy this band of adherents to Islam, you will not be worshiped upon the earth.
note: It has been narrated on the authority of `Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) who said: When it was the day on which the Battle of Badr was fought, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cast a glance at the infidels, and they were one thousand while his own Companions were three hundred and nineteen. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned (his face) towards the Qibla. Then he stretched his hands and began his supplication to his Lord: (The dua mentioned above)

name: The supplication of the believers and the help of Allah
uthmani: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّي مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍ مِّنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ
indopak: اِذْ تَسْتَغِيْثُوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ اَنِّيْ مُمِدُّكُمْ بِاَلْفٍ مِّنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُرْدِفِيْنَ
clean: اذ تستغيثون ربكم فاستجاب لكم اني ممدكم بالف من الملاءكه مردفين
translation: [Remember] when you asked help of your Lord, and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another." (Sura Anfal 8:9)
note:
He (Rasulullah ﷺ) continued his supplication to his Lord, stretching his hands, facing the Qibla, until his mantle slipped down from his shoulders. So Abu Bakr (RA) came to him, picked up his mantle and put it on his shoulders. Then he embraced him from behind and said: O Prophet of Allah (ﷺ), this prayer of yours to your Lord will suffice you, and He will fulfill for you what He has promised you. So Allah, the Glorious and Exalted, revealed (the Qur'anic verse): (The ayaat is mentioned above) 

So Allah helped him with angels.

name: Allah's help upon the Mujahideen #1
content: Narrated to him by Ibn `Abbas (RA) who said: While on that day a Muslim was chasing a disbeliever who was going ahead of him, he heard over him the swishing of the whip and the voice of the rider saying: Go ahead, Haizum! [1] He glanced at the polytheist who had (now) fallen down on his back. When he looked at him (carefully he found that) there was a scar on his nose and his face was torn as if it had been lashed with a whip, and had turned green with its poison. An Ansari came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and related this (event) to him. He said: You have told the truth. This was the help from the third heaven. The Muslims that day (i.e. the day of the Battle of Badr) killed seventy persons and captured seventy. [2]
reference:
[1] Name of the horse carrying the angel (translator)
[2] Muslim: 1763

name: Allah's help upon the Mujahideen #2
uthmani: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا ﴿٩﴾ إِذْ جَاءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّهِ الظُّنُونَا ﴿١٠﴾ هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا ﴿١١﴾
indopak: يَا اَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اذْكُرُوْا نِعْمَةَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ اِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُوْدٌ فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيْحًا وَجُنُوْدًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرًا ﴿٩﴾ اِذْ جَاءُوْكُمْ مِّنْ فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ اَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَاِذْ زَاغَتِ الْاَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوْبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ الظُّنُوْنَا ﴿١٠﴾ هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ وَزُلْزِلُوْا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيْدًا ﴿١١﴾
clean: يا ايها الذين امنوا اذكروا نعمه الله عليكم اذ جاءتكم جنود فارسلنا عليهم ريحا وجنودا لم تروها  وكان الله بما تعملون بصيرا ٩ اذ جاءوكم من فوقكم ومن اسفل منكم واذ زاغت الابصار وبلغت القلوب الحناجر وتظنون بالله الظنونا ١٠ هنالك ابتلي المءمنون وزلزلوا زلزالا شديدا ١١
translation: (9) O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see. And ever is Allah, of what you do, Seeing. (10) [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats and you assumed about Allah [various] assumptions. (11) There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.

name: Dua of the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of the battle of Ahzab
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ اِهْزِمِ الْأَحْزَابَ اَللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ سَرِيْعَ الْحِسَابِ اِهْزِمِ الْاَحْزَابَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
clean: اللهم منزل الكتاب سريع الحساب اهزم الاحزاب اللهم اهزمهم وزلزلهم
transliteration: Allaahumma munzilal-kitaabi, saree'al-hisaabi, ihzimil-'ahzaaba, Allaahummah zimhum wa zalzilhum.
translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, swift in (taking) account, put the tribes to rout. O Lord, defeat them and shake them.
note: In the battle of Ahzaab, those who fought with The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), they were five kinds: Polytheists of Makkah, Polytheists of various tribes of Arab, Jews who came from outside the madina, Banu Quraiza and the hypocrites. There were ten thousands disbelievers in the front of trench and with the Prophet (ﷺ), there were three thousands Muslims. The disbelievers surrounded Prophet (ﷺ) for 1 month. There was no fighting between them, but there was an incident where a fighting took place Ali ibn Abi Taalib (RA) with Amar ibn Udd Amiri. Ali (RA) killed him. This was the fourth year after Hijrah. In that battle The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) invoked Allah against them - (The dua is mentioned above)

name: Dua of the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of the battle of Hunain
uthmani: شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوْهُ
indopak: شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوْهُ
clean: شاهت الوجوه
transliteration: Shaahatil wujooh
translation: May these faces be deformed!
note:
This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Salama ibnul akwa (RA) who said: We fought by the side of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Hunain. When we encountered the enemy, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got down from his mule. picked up a handful of dust from the ground, threw it into their (enemy) faces and said: (the dua is mentioned above)

There was no one among the enemy whose eyes were not filled with the dust from this handful. So, they turned back fleeing. and Allah the Exalted and Glorious defeated them, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) distributed their booty among the Muslims.

name: Blessed masnun dua #1
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَسُوْءِ الْقَضَاءِ وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَسُوْءِ الْقَضَاءِ وَشَمَاتَةِ الْاَعْدَاءِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من جهد البلاء ودرك الشقاء وسوء القضاء وشماته الاعداء
transliteration: Allaahumma innee ‘a’oodhu bika min jahdil-balaa’i, wa darakish-shaqaa’i, wa soo’il qadhaa’i, wa shamaatatil-‘a’adaa
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with Allah from the difficult moment of a calamity and from being overtaken by destruction and from being destined to an evil end, and from the malicious joy of enemies.

name: Blessed masnun dua #2
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، اَللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِيْ تَقْوَاهَا وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا.
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اٰتِ نَفْسِيْ تَقْوَاهَا وَزَكِّهَا اَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَّكَّاهَا اَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا، اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَّا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَّا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَّا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَّا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من العجز والكسل والجبن والبخل والهرم وعذاب القبر اللهم ات نفسي تقواها وزكها انت خير من زكاها انت وليها ومولاها اللهم اني اعوذ بك من علم لا ينفع ومن قلب لا يخشع ومن نفس لا تشبع ومن دعوه لا يستجاب لها
transliteration: Allaahumma innee a‛oodhu bika minal ‛ajzi wal-kasali, wal-jubni wal-bukhli, wal harami wa ‛adhaabil-qabr, Allaahumma aati nafsee taq-waahaa wa zakkihaa anta khairu man zakkaahaa anta wali-yuhaa wa mawlaahaa, Allaahumma inni a‛oodhu bika min ‛ilmin laa yanfa‛u, wa min qalbin laa yakh-sha‛u, wa min nafsin laa tashba‛u, wa min da‛wat-in laa yustajaabu lahaa
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from weakness, and laziness, cowardice and miserliness, old and infirm age, and the torment of the grave. O Allah, give my soul piety and purify it, for indeed You are the best of those who can purify it, You are it's Guardian and Master. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not get humbled [to Allah], from a soul which is never satisfied and from a supplication which does not get answered.

name: Blessed masnun dua #3
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيْعِ سَخَطِكَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيْعِ سَخَطِكَ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من زوال نعمتك وتحول عافيتك وفجاءه نقمتك وجميع سخطك
transliteration: Allaahumma inni A‛oodhu bika min zawaali ni'matika, wa tahawwuli 'afiyatika, wa fujaa-ati niqmatika, wa jami'i sakhatik
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the withdrawal of your blessing and the change of your protection (from me) and from the sudden  your wrath, and from your every displeasure.

name: Blessed masnun dua #4
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يَنْفَعُنِي حُبُّهُ عِنْدَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ مَا رَزَقْتَنِي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ قُوَّةً لِي فِيمَا تُّحِبُّ، اَللَّهُمَّ وَمَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ لِي فَرَاغًا فِيمَا تُحِبُّ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِيْ حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يَّنْفَعُنِيْ حُبُّهُ عِنْدَكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ مَا رَزَقْتَنِيْ مِمَّا اُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ قُوَّةً لِّيْ فِيْمَا تُّحِبُّ، اَللّٰهُمَّ وَمَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّيْ مِمَّا اُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ لِيْ فَرَاغًا فِيْمَا تُحِبُّ
clean: اللهم ارزقني حبك وحب من ينفعني حبه عندك اللهم ما رزقتني مما احب فاجعله قوه لي فيما تحب اللهم وما زويت عني مما احب فاجعله لي فراغا فيما تحب
transliteration: Allaahummar zuqni 'hubbaka, wa 'hubba man yanfa’uni 'hubbuhu ‘indaka. Allaahumma maa razaqtani mimma u'hibbu faaj’alhu quwwatan lee fimaa tu'hibbu. Allaahumma wa maa zawaita ‘anni mimma u'hibbu faaj’alhu lee faraaghan fimaa tu'hibbu
translation: O Allah grant me Your love and the love of those whose love will benefit me. O Allah, whatever you have provided me of that which I love, make it strength for me for achieving  that which You love. O Allah, and what you have kept from me of that which I love, then make it for me a period of rest for achieving that which You love.

name: Blessed masnun dua #5
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ زِدْنَا وَلَا تَنْقُصْنَا وَأَكْرِمْنَا وَلَا تُهِنَّا وَأَعْطِنَا وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا وَآثِرْنَا وَلَا تُؤْثِرْ عَلَيْنَا وَأَرْضِنَا وَارْضَ عَنَّا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ زِدْنَا وَلَا تَنْقُصْنَا وَاَكْرِمْنَا وَلَا تُهِنَّا وَاَعْطِنَا وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا وَاٰثِرْنَا وَلَا تُؤْثِرْ عَلَيْنَا وَاَرْضِنَا وَارْضَ عَنَّا
clean: اللهم زدنا ولا تنقصنا واكرمنا ولا تهنا واعطنا ولا تحرمنا واثرنا ولا توثر علينا وارضنا وارض عنا
transliteration: Allaahumma zidnaa wa laa tanqusnaa, wa akrimnaa wa laa tuhinnaa, wa aa-tinaa wa laa tahrimnaa, wa athir-naa wa laa tu-'thir ‘alaynaa, wa ardinaa warda ‘annaa
translation: O Allah! Increase us [in Your Blessings] and do not decrease us, honor us and do not humiliate us, give us [from Your Gifts] and do not deprive us, be in favor of us and not against us, and make us satisfied and be satisfied with us.

name: Blessed masnun dua #6
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ الْهُدٰى وَالتُّقٰى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنٰى
clean: اللهم اني اسالك الهدي والتقي والعفاف والغني
transliteration: Allaahumma inni as-alukal hudaa wattuqa, wal 'afaafa wal ghinaa
translation: O Allah, indeed, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and sufficiency.

name: Blessed masnun dua #7
uthmani: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوْبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِيْ عَلَى دِيْنِكَ
indopak: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوْبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِىْ عَلٰى دِيْنِكَ
clean: يا مقلب القلوب ثبت قلبي علي دينك
transliteration: Ya Muqallibal-qulubi, thabbit qalbi `alaa dinik
translation: O Changer of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

name: Blessed masnun dua #8
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الْأُمُوْرِ كُلِّهَا، وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ خِزْيِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الْاُمُوْرِ كُلِّهَا، وَاَجِرْنَا مِنْ خِزْيِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْاٰخِرَةِ
clean: اللهم احسن عاقبتنا في الامور كلها واجرنا من خزي الدنيا وعذاب الاخره
transliteration: Allaahumma a’hsin ‘aaqibatanaa fil-umuri kullihaa, wa ajirnaa min khizy-id dunyaa wa adhaabil akhirah
translation: O Allah! grant us a good outcome on all of our affairs and save us from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter.

name: Epidemics and diseases #1
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُنُوْنِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُنُوْنِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْاَسْقَامِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من البرص والجنون والجذام ومن سيء الاسقام
transliteration: Allaahumma inni a‛oodhu bika minal-barasi, wal-jununi, wal-judhami, wa min sayyi'il-asqam
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from leprosy, madness, elephantiasis, and evil diseases.

name: Epidemics and diseases #2
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ حْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ قَائِمًا وَاحْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ قَاعِدًا وَحْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ رَاقِدًا وَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِي عَدُوًّا وَلَا حَسِدًا، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ خَزَائِنُهُ بِيَدِكَ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ خَزَائِنُهُ بِيَدِكَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ حْفَظْنِيْ بِالْاِسْلَامِ قَائِمًا وَاحْفَظْنِيْ بِالْاِسْلَامِ قَاعِدًا وَحْفَظْنِيْ بِالْاِسْلَامِ رَاقِدًا وَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِيْ عَدُوًّا وَلَا حَسِدًا، اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ خَزَائِنُهٗ بِيَدِكَ وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ خَزَائِنُهٗ بِيَدِكَ
clean: اللهم حفظني بالاسلام قاءما واحفظني بالاسلام قاعدا وحفظني بالاسلام راقدا ولا تشمت بي عدوا ولا حسدا اللهم اني اسالك من كل خير خزاءنه بيدك واعوذ بك من كل شر خزاءنه بيدك
transliteration: Allaahumma’h fazni bil-islaami qaa'iman wa’h faazni bil-islaami qaa'idan wa’h fazni bil-islaami raaqidan walaa tushmit bi ‘aduwan walaa ‘hasidan. Allaahumma inni as-aluka min kulli khayrin khazaa-inuhu bi yadik, wa A‛oodhu bika min kulli sharrin khazaa-inuhu bi yadik
translation: O Allah! Protect me with Islam when standing, and protect me with Islam when sitting down, and protect me with Islam when reclining, and do not make an enemy or envier rejoice at me. O Allah! I ask you for every good whose stores are in Your Hand, and I seek refuge with you from every evil whose stores are in Your Hand.

name: Epidemics and diseases #3
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوْسَعَ رِزْقِكَ عَلَىَّ عِنْدَ كِبَرِ سِنِّي وَانْقِطَاعِ عُمُرِي
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ اَوْسَعَ رِزْقِكَ عَلَىَّ عِنْدَ كِبَرِ سِنِّيْ وَانْقِطَاعِ عُمُرِيْ
clean: اللهم اجعل اوسع رزقك علي عند كبر سني وانقطاع عمري
transliteration: Allahumm-aj'al Awsa'a Rizqika Alayya inda kibari sinni wan qita-i umuri
translation: O Allah! Expand for me Your provision till my old age and till the end of my life.

name: Epidemics and diseases #4
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْقَسْوَةِ وَالْغَفْلَةِ وَالْعَيْلَةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ وَالْمَسْكَنَةِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْكُفْرِ وَالْفُسُوْقِ وَالشِّقَّاقِ وَالنِّفَقِ وَالسُّمْعَةِ والرِّيَاءِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الصَّمَمِ وَالْبَكَمِ وَالْجُنُوْنِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَالْبَرَصِ وَسَيِّءِ الْأَسْقَامِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْقَسْوَةِ وَالْغَفْلَةِ وَالْعَيْلَةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ وَالْمَسْكَنَةِ وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْكُفْرِ وَالْفُسُوْقِ وَالشِّقَّاقِ وَالنِّفَقِ وَالسُّمْعَةِ والرِّيَاءِ وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الصَّمَمِ وَالْبَكَمِ وَالْجُنُوْنِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَالْبَرَصِ وَسَيِّءِ الْاَسْقَامِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من العجز والكسل والجبن والبخل والهرم والقسوه والغفله والعيله والذله والمسكنه واعوذ بك من الفقر والكفر والفسوق والشقاق والنفق والسمعه والرياء واعوذ بك من الصمم والبكم والجنون والجذام والبرص وسيء الاسقام
transliteration: Allaahumma inni A‛oodhu bika minal-'ajzi, wal-kasali, wal-jubni, wal-bukhli, wal-harami, wal qaswati wal ghaflati wal’aylati wadh-dhillati wal maskanati wa a’uudhu bika minal faqri wal kufri wal fusuuqi wash-shiqaaqi wan nifaaqi was-sum’ati war-riyaai wa A‛oodhu bika minas-samami wal bakami wal junuuni wal judhaami wal barasi wasayyi-il-asqaam
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from Inability; lethargy; Cowardice, Miserliness, Senility, Hard heartedness, Heedlessness, Deprivation; Humiliation, misery; And I seek refuge in You from absolute poverty, Disbelief, Rebellion; Dissension, Hypocrisy, Seeking fame, And showing off, And I seek refuge in You from deafness, Being mute, Insanity; Leprosy, Leukederma, And from any worst kind of illness.

name: Epidemics and diseases #5
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ يَوْمِ السُّوءِ وَمِنْ لَيْلَةِ السُّوءِ وَمِنْ سَاعَةِ السُّوءِ وَمِنْ صَاحِبِ السُّوءِ وَمِنْ جَارِ السُّوءِ فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ يَّوْمِ السُّوْءِ وَمِنْ لَّيْلَةِ السُّوْءِ وَمِنْ سَاعَةِ السُّوْءِ وَمِنْ صَاحِبِ السُّوْءِ وَمِنْ جَارِ السُّوْءِ فِيْ دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من يوم السوء ومن ليله السوء ومن ساعه السوء ومن صاحب السوء ومن جار السوء في دار المقامه
transliteration: Allaahumma innee A‛oodhu bika min yawmis-suu’i, wa min laylatis-suu’i, wa min saa‛atis-suu’i, wa min saa’hibis-suu’i, wa min jaaris-suu’i fee daaril-muqaamah
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from bad days, bad nights, bad hours, bad companions, and bad neighbours in my place of residence.

name: Epidemics and diseases #6
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ انْفَعْنِيْ بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِيْ وَعَلِّمْنِيْ مَا تَنْفَعُنِيْ وَزِدْنِيْ عِلْمًا
clean: اللهم انفعني بما علمتني وعلمني ما تنفعني وزدني علما
transliteration: Allahum-manfa'ni bima 'al-lamtani, wa 'al-limni maa yanfa'uni, wa zidni 'ilma
translation: Oh Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me and teach me what benefits me, and increase me in knowledge.

name: Epidemics and diseases #7
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنِي بِسَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَاجْعَلْهُمَا الْوَارِثَ مِنِّي، وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنِي وَخُذْ مِنْهُ بِثَأْرِي
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَتِّعْنِيْ بِسَمْعِيْ وَبَصَرِيْ وَاجْعَلْهُمَا الْوَارِثَ مِنِّيْ، وَانْصُرْنِيْ عَلٰى مَنْ ظَلَمَنِيْ وَخُذْ مِنْهُ بِثَأْرِيْ
clean: اللهم متعني بسمعي وبصري واجعلهما الوارث مني وانصرني علي من ظلمني وخذ منه بثاري
transliteration: Allahumm-a matti‛ni bi sam‛i wa basari waj-‛alhumal-waaritha minni, wan-surni ‛alaa man zalamani, wa khudh minhu bi tha’ri
translation: O Allah, grant me enjoyment of my hearing and sight, and keep them healthy and sound until the day I die, and aid me against those who oppress me, and avenge me from them.

name: Protection from the Dajjal
content: Whoever memorizes ten 'Ayat (Verses) from the beginning of Surat Al-Kahf, will be protected from the False Messiah. One can also say in every prayer after the final Tashahhud before ending the prayer, seeking the protection of Allah from the trials of the False Messiah (Dajjal).

name: Dua for protecting from shirk
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَنْ اُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَاَنَا اَعْلَمُ، وَاَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا اَعْلَمُ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك ان اشرك بك وانا اعلم واستغفرك لما لا اعلم
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oodhu bika 'an 'ushrika bika wa 'anaa 'a'lamu, wa 'astaghfiruka limaa laa 'a'lamu
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.

name: Dua to one who pray blessings for you #1
content: Aaishah (radhi-yAllahu 'anhaa) reported that the Messenger of Allah (sal-Allahu 'alayhe wa sallam) was given a sheep and he ordered for it's distribution. When the servant would come back [from distributing it] , 'Aaishah would ask: "What did they say?", he replied: "They would supplicate:
uthmani: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيكُمْ
indopak: بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ فِيْكُمْ
clean: بارك الله فيكم
transliteration: BaarakAllahu feekum
translation: May Allah bless you all
note: Aaishah would then say :

name: Forbiddance of ascribing things to omens
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا طَيْرَ إِلَّا طَيْرُكَ، وَلَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا طَيْرَ اِلَّا طَيْرُكَ، وَلَا خَيْرَ اِلَّا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا اِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
clean: اللهم لا طير الا طيرك ولا خير الا خيرك ولا اله غيرك
transliteration: Allaahumma laa tayra 'illaa tayruka, wa laa khayra 'illaa khayruka, wa laa 'ilaaha ghayruka
translation: O Allah there is no portent other than Your portent, no goodness other than Your goodness, and none worthy of worship other than You. [1]
note: However, the Prophet (ﷺ) liked to take good omens. That is why when he heard a good word or a good word from a man, he liked it and said, I have taken your good word from your mouth. [2]
reference:
[1] Sahih (Albani). Ahmad: 7045
[2] Abu Dawud: 3719, Ahmad: 9040. See also Al-Albani, Silsilatul-'Ahadith As-Sahihah 2/363, and it is with Abu Ash-Shaikh Al-Asfahani in 'Akhlaqun-Nabiyy, pg. 270.

name: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
content:
The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him." [1] 

He (ﷺ) also said: "Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony. Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are." [2] 

He (ﷺ) also said: "The miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him, fails to send prayers upon me." [3] 

He (ﷺ) said: 'Allah has Angels who roam the earth and convey salaam to me from my ummah.'[4] 

He (ﷺ) also said: ''Whenever someone sends salaam upon me, Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return salaam to that person. [5]
reference:
[1] Muslim: 384
[2] Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 2042
[3] Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3546
[4] Sahih (Albani). Nasai: 1282
[5] Hasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 2041

name: When slaughtering or sacrificing an animal
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اَللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ [اَللّٰهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اَللّٰهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّيْ
clean: بسم الله والله اكبر اللهم منك ولك اللهم تقبل مني
transliteration: Bismillaahi wAllahu 'Akbar [Allaahumma minka wa laka] Allaahumma taqabbal minnee
translation: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great! [O Allah, from You and to You] O Allah, accept it from me.
reference: Muslim 3/1557, No. 1967, Bayhaaqi 9/287 (This part is between the brackets)

name: Upon hearing an ass bray or dogs barking
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيـمِ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
clean: اعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم
transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
note: Also "If you hear the barking of dogs or the braying of asses at night, seek refuge in Allah for they see what you do not." [1]

name: To ward off the deception of the Obstinate Shaytans
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِيْ لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَّلَا فَاجِرٌ مِّنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَاَ وَذَرَاَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَاَ فِي الْاَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ اِلَّا طَارِقًا يَّطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَّا رَحْمٰنُ
clean: اعوذ بكلمات الله التامات التي لا يجاوزهن بر ولا فاجر من شر ما خلق وبرا وذرا ومن شر ما ينزل من السماء ومن شر ما يعرج فيها ومن شر ما ذرا في الارض ومن شر ما يخرج منها ومن شر فتن الليل والنهار ومن شر كل طارق الا طارقا يطرق بخير يا رحمن
transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaatil-latee laa yujaawizuhunna barrun wa laa faajirum min sharri maa khalaqa, wa bara'a wa dhara'a, wa min sharri maa yanzilu minas-samaa'i, wa min sharri maa ya'ruju feehaa, wa min sharri maa dhara'a fil-'ardhi, wa min sharri ma yakhruju minhaa, wa min sharri fitanil-layli wannahaari, wa min sharri kulli taariqin 'illaa taariqan yatruqu bikhayrin yaa Rahmaan
translation: I take refuge within Allah"s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. [I take refuge] from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. [I take refuge] from the evil that is spread on earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.
reference: Sheikh Arnaut (R) regarded this chain of narration as Sahih in Takhriju lita’habiyyah (P.133)

name: Seeking Forgiveness & Repentance
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) added: The person who says:
uthmani: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ
indopak: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ الْعَظِيْمَ الَّذِيْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ وَاَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ
clean: استغفر الله العظيم الذي لا اله الا هو الحي القيوم واتوب اليه
transliteration: Astaghfirullaahal-'Adheemal-ladhee laa 'ilaaha 'illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoomu wa 'atoobu 'ilayhi
translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.
note:
Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army." [1]

He (ﷺ) said: "The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so." [2]

He (ﷺ) also said: "The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein." [3]

He (ﷺ) also said: "Verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah"s forgiveness a hundred times a day." [4]
reference:
[1] Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1517
[2] Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3579
[3] Muslim: 482
[4] Muslim: 2702

name: Upon seeing the early or premature fruit
content: Abu Hurairah (RA) said that people used to bring new fruits to the Prophet (ﷺ). The Prophet (ﷺ) used to accept it and say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْ ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْ مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْ صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْ مُدِّنَا
clean: اللهم بارك لنا في ثمرنا وبارك لنا في مدينتنا وبارك لنا في صاعنا وبارك لنا في مدنا
transliteration: Allaahumma baarik lanaa fee thamarinaa, wa baarik lanaa fee madeenatinaa wa baarik lanaa fee saa'inaa, wa baarik lanaa fee muddinaa
translation: O Allah, bless us in our dates and bless us in our town, bless us in our Sa' and in our Mudd.

name: Protect mind from affection towards sins
content: To protect mind from attracting towards sins, prophet (ﷺ) used to say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنِّي اَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْاَخْلَاقِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَهْوَاءِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْاَخْلَاقِ وَالْاَعْمَالِ وَالْاَهْوَاءِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من منكرات الاخلاق والاعمال والاهواء
transliteration: Allaahumma inni a`udhu bika min munkaraatil-akhlaaqi wal-a`maali wal-ahwaa
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil character, evil actions, and evil desires.

name: Dua for saving the eyes, ears, tongue and heart from evil
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنِّي اَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِيْ وَمِنْ شَرِّ بَصَرِيْ وَمِنْ شَرِّ لِسَانِيْ وَمِنْ شَرِّ قَلْبِيْ مِنْ شَرِّ مَنِيِّيْ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِيْ وَمِنْ شَرِّ بَصَرِيْ وَمِنْ شَرِّ لِسَانِيْ وَمِنْ شَرِّ قَلْبِيْ مِنْ شَرِّ مَنِيِّيْ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من شر سمعي ومن شر بصري ومن شر لساني ومن شر قلبي من شر منيي
transliteration: Allaahumma inni a`udhu bika min sharri sam`i wa min sharri basari, wa min sharri lisaani, wa min sharri qalbi, wa min sharri maniyyi
translation: O Allah, indeed I seek refuge in You from the evil of my hearing and the evil of my sight, and the evil of my tongue and the evil of my heart, and the evil of my semen.

name: Dua for holding oneself in obedience to Allah
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوْبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوْبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوْبَنَا عَلٰى طَاعَتِكَ
clean: اللهم مصرف القلوب صرف قلوبنا علي طاعتك
transliteration: Allaahumma musarrifal-qulubi, sarrif qulubanaa 'alaa taa'atik
translation: O Allah! Controller of the hearts, direct our hearts to Your obedience. [1]

name: Expressing gratitude to the benefactor
uthmani: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
indopak: جَزَاكَ اللّٰهُ خَيْرًا
clean: جزاك الله خيرا
transliteration: JazaakAllahu khayran
translation: May Allah reward you with good.
note: We have seen that the believer never expects gratitude or recompense from anyone who benefits him. On the other hand, it is the duty of the beneficent believer to express gratitude to the benefactor, to praise him, to openly acknowledge his beneficence, and to pray for him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If someone does good to someone and he gives thanks to the benefactor by saying this, then it will be best appreciated.

name: Dua for watching oneself in the mirror
content: Rasul (ﷺ) used to say when watching himself in the mirror:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقِي
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِيْ فَاَحْسِنْ خُلُقِيْ
clean: اللهم حسنت خلقي فاحسن خلقي
transliteration: Allaahumma hassanta khalqi fa a'hsin khuluqi
translation: O Allah, just as You have made my external features beautiful, make my character beautiful as well.

name: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
content: Narrated Abu Hurayrah (RA): The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone invokes blessings on me once, Allah will bless him ten times.

name: Virtues of reciting salutation upon prophet (ﷺ)
content: Ubayy ibn ka'b (RA) said: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Indeed I say very much Salat for you. How much of my Salat should I make for you?' He (ﷺ) said: 'As you wish.'" [He said:] "I said: 'A fourth?' He (ﷺ) said: 'As you wish. But if you add more it would be better for you.' I said: 'Then half?' He (ﷺ) said: 'As you wish. And if you add more it would be better [for you].'" [He said:] "I said: 'Then two-thirds? 'He (ﷺ) said: 'As you wish, but if you add more it would be better for you.' I said: 'Should I make all of my Salat for you?' He (ﷺ) said: 'Then your problems would be solved and your sins would be forgiven.'
note: This hadith tell us to increase sending prayers upon the Prophet. Only authentically proved prayers from the Quran and Sunnah should be recited in this regard.

name: Ask for paradise & protection from fire
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ النَّارِ
clean: اللهم اني اسالك الجنه واعوذ بك من النار
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-jannata wa 'A'oodhu bika minan-naar
translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire.

name: What to be said if someone ask for dua?
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَهُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَكْثِرْ مَالَهٗ وَوَلَدَهُ وَبَارِكْ لَهٗ فِيْمَا اَعْطَيْتَهٗ
clean: اللهم اكثر ماله وولده وبارك له فيما اعطيته
transliteration: Allaahummakthir maa-lahu wa waladahu wa baarik lahu fiimaa a-'ataitahu
translation: O Allah! Increase his wealth and children, and bestow Your Blessing on whatever You give him.
note: Anas ibn Malik (RA) said, "My mother took me to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and said, 'O Messenger of Allah!' Pray to Allah for this little servant of yours, Anas. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said: (The dua is mentioned above)

name: When surprised
content: Upon hearing astonishing thing, companions said:
uthmani: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
indopak: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ
clean: سبحان الله
transliteration: SubhaanAllah
translation: Glory is to Allah.

name: Upon receiving pleasant news
content: When the Prophet (ﷺ) received any good news, he would prostrate to express his gratitude to Allah.

name: Dua for one in distress
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say when faced with any misfortune:
uthmani: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
indopak: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ
clean: يا حي يا قيوم برحمتك استغيث
transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoomu bira'hmatika 'astagheeth
translation: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your Mercy I seek help.

name: A very beautiful Dua or Dhikr
uthmani:
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا خَلَقَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَى كِتَابُهُ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مِلْءَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
سُبْحَانَ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ، وَسُبْحَانَ لِلَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا خَلَقَ، وَسُبْحَانَ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ، وَسُبْحَانَ لِلَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ، وَسُبْحَانَ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَى كِتَابُهُ، وَسُبْحَانَ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَسُبْحَانَ لِلَّهِ مِلْءَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
indopak:
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ مِلْءَ مَا خَلَقَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَدَدَ مَا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ مِلْءَ مَا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَدَدَ مَا اَحْصٰى كِتَابُهُ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ مِلْءَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ

سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ مِلْءَ مَا خَلَقَ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ عَدَدَ مَا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ مِلْءَ مَا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ عَدَدَ مَا اَحْصٰى كِتَابُهُ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِلْءَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
clean: الحمد لله عدد ما خلق والحمد لله ملء ما خلق والحمد لله عدد ما في الارض والسماء والحمد لله ملء ما في الارض والسماء والحمد لله عدد ما احصي كتابه والحمد لله عدد كل شيء والحمد لله ملء كل شيءسبحان الله عدد ما خلق وسبحان الله ملء ما خلق وسبحان الله عدد ما في الارض والسماء وسبحان الله ملء ما في الارض والسماء وسبحان الله عدد ما احصي كتابه وسبحان الله عدد كل شيء وسبحان الله ملء كل شيء
transliteration:
Alhamdulillahi 'Adada Ma Khalaqa, Walhamdulillahi Mil'a Ma Khalaqa, Walhamdulillahi 'Adada Ma fil Ardi Was Samayi, Walhamdulillahi Mil'a Ma fil Ardi Was Samayi, Walhamdullahi 'Adada Ma a’hsaa kitabuhu, Walhamdullahi 'Adada Kulli Shayin, Walhamdullahi Mil'a Kulli Shayin.

Subhanallahi 'Adada Ma Khalaqa, Wa Subhanallahi Mil'a Ma Khalaqa, Wa Subhanallahi 'Adada Ma fil Ardi Was Samayi, Wa Subhanallahi Mil'a Ma fil Ardi Was Samayi, Wa Subhanallahi 'Adada Ma a’hsaa kitabuhu, Wa Subhanallahi 'Adada Kulli Shayin, Wa Subhanallahi Mil'a Kulli Shayin.
translation:
Praise be to Allah equal to His creation, praise be to Allah for the fullness of His creation, praise be to Allah equal to what is in the heavens and earth, praise be to Allah equal to what His Book has counted, praise be to Allah full of what His Book has counted, praise be to Allah equal to the quantity of all things and the praise of Allah are full of all things.

I am glorifying Allah equal to His creation, I am glorifying Allah for the fullness of His creation, I am glorifying Allah equal to what is in the heavens and earth, I am glorifying Allah equal to what His Book has counted, pI am glorifying Allah full of what His Book has counted, I am glorifying Allah equal to the quantity of all things and I am glorifying Allah full of all things.
note:
The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) said to Abu Umama Bahili (may Allaah be pleased with him), “Shall I not teach you a du'aa/dhikr that is better than all day and night (naafil) dhikr?

Learn this du'aa/dhikr yourself, and teach it to those who will come after you."

name: Before starting anything
content: When you start something, eating,drinking,writing, reading something start saying ‘Bismillah’ -
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ
clean: بسم الله
transliteration: Bismillaah
translation: In the Name of Allah.
note: Narrated 'Umar ibn Abi Salamah (RA): I was a boy under the care of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). While eating, I would put my hands in different places of the pot. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, “This boy! Say Bismillah, eat, and the next part of your right to eat! "After the meal, I'm going to follow the instructions.

name: Intended to do something in the future
uthmani: إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
indopak: اِنْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ
clean: ان شاء الله
transliteration: inshaa'Allah
translation: If Allah wills.
note: And never say of anything, "Indeed, I will do that tomorrow," Except [when adding], "If Allah wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."

name: If you see any Superiority, Highness, or Greatness of Allah
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu Akbaar
translation: Allah is great.

name: Seeing any surprisingly good things
uthmani: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
indopak: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ
clean: سبحان الله
transliteration: Sub’hanallah
translation: How perfect Allah is

name: Eating something good / listening to the good news
uthmani: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
indopak: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ
clean: الحمد لله
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaah
translation: All praise is for Allah.
note: It was narrated from Anas that : the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Allah does not bestow a blessing upon any slave and he says: 'Al-hamdu Lillah (praise is to Allah),' except that what he gives (the praise) is better than what he received (the blessing)."

name: Danger/Bad news, something lost/stolen
content: Hearing of danger or something bad news, when something is lost, or something is stolen or in trouble
uthmani: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ
indopak: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ
clean: انا لله
transliteration: Innaa lillaahi
translation: We are from Allah.

name: An expression of appreciation/seeing something good
uthmani: مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ
indopak: مَا شَاءَ ٱللّٰهْ
clean: ما شاء لله
transliteration: ma sha Allah
translation: That which Allah wanted.

name: Expressing gratitude to the benefactor
uthmani: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
indopak: جَزَاكَ اللّٰهُ خَيْرًا
clean: جزاك الله خيرا
transliteration: JazaakAllahu khayran
translation: May Allah reward you with good. [1]
note: We have seen that the believer never expects gratitude or recompense from anyone who benefits him. On the other hand, it is the duty of the beneficent believer to express gratitude to the benefactor, to praise him, to openly acknowledge his beneficence, and to pray for him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If someone does good to someone and he gives thanks to the benefactor by saying this, then it will be best appreciated. [2]

name: Dua upon sneezing
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, If one of you sneezes, let him say:
uthmani: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
indopak: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ
clean: الحمد لله
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaah
translation: All praise is for Allah. [1]
note: After sneezing "Alhamdu lillahi 'ala qulli ha-l". have to be said or at least say "Al-Hamdulillah".

name: If you hear the sneezer say (Alhamdulillah), the listener will say -
uthmani: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
indopak: يَرْحَمُكَ اللّٰهُ
clean: يرحمك الله
transliteration: Yarhamuk-Allah
translation: May Allah have mercy upon you.

name: Speaking of bad things
uthmani: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
indopak: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ
clean: استغفر الله
transliteration: astaghfir-ullaah
translation: I seek Allah’s forgiveness.
note: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place.

name: In response to How are you?
uthmani: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
indopak: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ
clean: الحمد لله
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaah
translation: All praise is for Allah.

name: If something unpleasant happens/hearing bad things
content: If you hear any bad words or if you hear or remember the punishment and wrath of Allah-
uthmani: نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ
indopak: نَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ
clean: نعوذ بالله
transliteration: NA‛oodhu billaah
translation: I seek refuge with Allah.

name: Hearing any news of death/unpleasant
uthmani: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ
indopak: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَاِنَّا اِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ
clean: انا لله وانا اليه راجعون
transliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa 'innaa 'ilayhi raaji'oon
translation: We are from Allah and unto Him we return.

name: At the end of the prayer
uthmani: آمِينْ
indopak: اٰمِينْ
clean: امين
transliteration: Aamin
translation: (Oh Allah) accept our invocation.
reference: Sahih Lee Ghairihi (Albani). Targib wat Tarhib, 2/66

name: When getting up
content: Narrated Jabir bin Abdillah (RA): He said, "When we ascended, we would say:
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu Akbaar
translation: Allah is great.

name: When getting down
content: And when descend, we said -
uthmani: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
indopak: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ
clean: سبحان الله
transliteration: Sub’hanallah
translation: How perfect Allah is.
note: Can be read while going up and down the stairs/elevator

name: Having doubt in speech
uthmani: وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ‏
indopak: وَاللّٰهُ أَعْلَمُ‏
clean: والله اعلم
transliteration: Wallahu a'lam
translation: Allah knows better.

name: When slaughtering an animal
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: بسم الله والله اكبر
transliteration: Bismillaahi wAllahu 'Akbar
translation: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great!
note: Anas (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) placed his feet on the two jaws of a goat with white and black horns and sacrificed him saying Bismillahi wAllahu akbar.

name: After winning or hope to win
uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu Akbaar
translation: Allah is great.

name: If you meet someone
uthmani: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
indopak: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
clean: السلام عليكم ورحمه الله وبركاته
transliteration: As-salaamu 'alaykum wara'hmatullaahi wa barakaatuh
translation: Peace be upon you, and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings.
note: A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: As-salaamu 'alaykum! He responded to his salutation. He then sat down. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Ten. Another man came and said: As-salaamu 'alaykum wara'hmatullaah! He responded to his salutation when he sat down. He said: Twenty. Another man came and said: As-salaamu 'alaykum wara'hmatullaahi wa barakaatuh! He responded to him and said when he sat down: Thirty.

name: To avoid Satan's whispers or deceptions
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
clean: اعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم
transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

name: Dua when the sun rises
content: This Dua should be recited when the sun rises:
uthmani: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ أَقَالَنَا يَوْمَنَا هٰذَا وَلَمْ يُهْلِكْنَا بِذُنُوْبِنَا
indopak: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ اَقَالَنَا يَوْمَنَا هٰذَا وَلَمْ يُهْلِكْنَا بِذُنُوْبِنَا
clean: الحمد لله الذي اقالنا يومنا هذا ولم يهلكنا بذنوبنا
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhi aqaalanaa yawmanaa hadhaa wa-lam yuh-liknaa bi-dhunubinaa
translation: All praise (and innumerable thanks) to Allah, Who has shown us this day, and did not destroy us for our (past) sins.

name: Dua to seek refuge from fitna
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنَّا نَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَنْ نَرْجِعَ عَلٰى أَعْقَابِنَا أَوْ نُفْتَنَ عَنْ دِيْنِنَا.
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَنْ نَرْجِعَ عَلٰى اَعْقَابِنَا اَوْ نُفْتَنَ عَنْ دِيْنِنَا.
clean: اللهم انا نعوذ بك ان نرجع علي اعقابنا او نفتن عن ديننا
transliteration: Allaahumma inna nau’dhu bika an narji’ya ‘alaa a’qaabinaa aw nuftana an dininaa.
translation: O Allah, we seek refuge with You from turning on our heels, or being put to trial in our religion.

name: Seeking security in this world and in the Hereafter
uthmani: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
indopak: اَسْاَلُ اللّٰهَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ
clean: اسال الله العافيه في الدنيا والاخره
transliteration: As’alullaahal ‘aafiyata feed dunyaa wal akhirah.
translation: I seek security from Allah in this World and Hereafter.

name: Dua for getting the right guidance
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَهْدِيكَ لِأَرْشَدِ أَمْرِي، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِيْ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْتَهْدِيْكَ لِاَرْشَدِ اَمْرِيْ، وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِيْ
clean: اللهم اني استهديك لارشد امري واعوذ بك من شر نفسي
transliteration: Allahumma inni astahdika li-arshadi amri, wa ‘auzubika min sharri nafsi
translation: O Allah, I seek guidance from You in all matters, and I seek refuge in You from my own evil.

name: Dua to save from the evil of the waning moon
uthmani: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ هٰذَا الغَاسِقِ
indopak: اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْ شَرِّ هٰذَا الْغَاسِقِ
clean: اعوذ بالله من شر هذا الغاسق
transliteration: A‛oodhu Billahi Min Sharri Haazal Gasiq
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the misfortune of this disappearing moon.

name: Dua to stay safe from the evil of the nafs
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ قِنِيْ شَرَّ نَفْسِيْ، وَاعْزِمْ لِيْ عَلٰى أَرْشَدِ أَمْرِيْ اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ مَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَخْطَأْتُ وَمَا عَمَدْتُّ، وَمَا جَهِلْتُ.
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ قِنِيْ شَرَّ نَفْسِيْ، وَاعْزِمْ لِيْ عَلٰى اَرْشَدِ اَمْرِيْ اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ مَا اَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا اَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا اَخْطَاْتُ وَمَا عَمَدْتُّ، وَمَا جَهِلْتُ.
clean: اللهم قني شر نفسي واعزم لي علي ارشد امري اللهم اغفر لي ما اسررت وما اعلنت وما اخطات وما عمدت وما جهلت
transliteration: Allaahumma qini sharra nafsi, wa’jim lee alaa arshadi amri, Allaahummaghfir lee maa as’rartu wa maa a’lantu wa maa akhta’tu wa maa amadtu wa maa jahiltu.
translation: O Allah, keep me safe from the evil of my soul. Give me a strong will to do good in all things. O Allah, forgive me all that I have done openly and secretly, that which I have done willingly and unwillingly, and that which I have done in ignorance.

name: Tashahhud #1
uthmani: اَلتَّحِيَّاتُ الْمُبَارَكَاتُ الصَّلَوَاتُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ لِلَّهِ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
indopak: اَلتَّحِيَّاتُ الْمُبَارَكَاتُ الصَّلَوَاتُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ لِلّٰهِ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلٰى عِبَادِ اللّٰهِ الصَّالِحِيْنَ اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَّسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ
clean: التحيات المباركات الصلوات الطيبات لله السلام عليك ايها النبي ورحمه الله وبركاته السلام علينا وعلي عباد الله الصالحين اشهد ان لا اله الا الله واشهد ان محمدا رسول الله
transliteration: Attahiyyaatul muba’rakaatus salawaatut, tayyibaatu lillaahi, assalaamu 'alayka 'ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuhu, assalaamu 'alaynaa wa 'alaa 'ibaadillaahis-saaliheen. 'Ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wa 'ash-hadu 'anna Muhammadar Rasoolullaah.
translation: All the blessed compliments and all the holy prayers are only for Allah. Peace be on you, O Prophet, and Allah’s mercy and blessings (are on you). And peace be on us and on the good (pious) worshipers of Allah.I bear witness that there is no true God except Allah. I further testify that Muhammad (peace be upon him) is the Messenger of Allah.

name: Tashahhud #2
uthmani: اَلتَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ اَلزَّاكِيَاتُ لِلَّهِ، اَلطَّيِّبَاتُ الصَّلَوَتُ لِلَّهِ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلٰى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ ورَسُولُهُ
indopak: اَلتَّحِيَّاتُ لِلّٰهِ اَلزَّاكِيَاتُ لِلّٰهِ، اَلطَّيِّبَاتُ الصَّلَوَاتُ لِلّٰهِ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلٰى عِبَادِ اللّٰهِ الصَّالِحِيْنَ، اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ، وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ ورَسُوْلُهُ
clean: التحيات لله الزاكيات لله الطيبات الصلوات لله السلام عليك ايها النبي ورحمه الله وبركاته السلام علينا وعلي عباد الله الصالحين اشهد ان لا اله الا الله واشهد ان محمدا عبده ورسوله
transliteration: Attahiyyaatu lillaahi ajjakiyaatu lillaahi,  Attayyibaatus salawaatu lillaahi, assalaamu 'alayka 'ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuhu, assalaamu 'alaynaa wa 'alaa 'ibaadillaahis-saaliheen. 'Ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wa 'ash-hadu 'anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluh.
translation: All the blessed compliments, all the good deeds and all the holy prayers are only for Allah. Peace be on you, O Prophet, and Allah’s mercy and blessings (are on you). And peace be on us and on the good (pious) worshipers of Allah. I bear witness that there is no true God except Allah. I further testify that Muhammad (peace be upon him) is the Messenger of Allah.

name: If you sneeze during the prayer
uthmani: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ مُبَارَكًا عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ رَبُّنَا وَيَرْضَى
indopak: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيْرًا طَيِّبًا مُّبَارَكًا فِيْهِ مُبَارَكًا عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ رَبُّنَا وَيَرْضٰى
clean: الحمد لله حمدا كثيرا طيبا مباركا فيه مباركا عليه كما يحب ربنا ويرضي
transliteration: Alhamdulillaahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubaarakan fih, mubarakan 'alayhi, kama yuhibbu rabbuna wa yarda.
translation: Praise be to Allah, much good and blessed praise as our Lord loves and is pleased with.

name: Dua in rukoo #9
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي، خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي وَمَا اِسْتَقَلَّتْ بِهِ قَدَمِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ، وَبِكَ اٰمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ اَسْلَمْتُ، اَنْتَ رَبِّيْ، خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِيْ وَبَصَرِيْ وَمُخِّيْ وَعَظْمِيْ وَعَصَبِيْ وَمَا اِسْتَقَلَّتْ بِهِ قَدَمِيْ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
clean: اللهم لك ركعت وبك امنت ولك اسلمت انت ربي خشع لك سمعي وبصري ومخي وعظمي وعصبي وما استقلت به قدمي لله رب العالمين
transliteration: Allahumma laka raka’tu wa bika amantu wa laka aslamtu, anta rabbi khasha’a laka sam’i wa basari wa mukh-khi wa ‘azmi wa ‘asabi wa ma istaqallat bihi qadami lillahi rabbil ‘alamin
translation: O Allah, I have bowed down to You, I have believed, I have surrendered. You are my Rabb, my ear-eye, my brain, my bones, my spine and my legs, all that you are carrying (i.e. my existence) have been humbled before Allah Almighty.

name: At the beginning of the prayer #1
uthmani: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
indopak: سُبْحَانَكَ اللّٰهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالٰى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا اِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
clean: سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك وتبارك اسمك وتعالي جدك ولا اله غيرك
transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa ta'aalaa jadduka, wa laa 'ilaaha ghayruk.
translation: Glory is to You O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your Name and Exalted is Your Majesty. There is none worthy of worship but You.

name: Dua in rukoo #10
uthmani: سُبْحَانَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
indopak: سُبْحَانَكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
clean: سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك لا اله الا انت
transliteration: Subhaanaka allahumma wa bihamdika, laa ilaaha illaa anta.
translation: O Allah glory is to You; there is no worthy of worship except You.

name: Dua while in a state of rukoo #7
uthmani: لِرَبِّيَ الْحَمْدُ
indopak: لِرَبِّيَ الْحَمْدُ
clean: لربي الحمد
transliteration: li-rabbi-al hamd
translation: To my Lord belongs all praise

name: Dua Mathurah #16
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَرَمِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَرَمِ، وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ
clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من الكسل واعوذ بك من الجبن واعوذ بك من الهرم واعوذ بك من البخل
transliteration: Allaahumma innee A‛oodhu bika minal kasali, wa A‛oodhu bika minal jubni, wa A‛oodhu bika minal harami, wa A‛oodhu bika minal bukhl.
translation: O Allah! I seek refuge with You from laziness, and seek refuge with You from cowardice, and seek refuge with You from geriatric old age, and seek refuge with You from miserliness.

name: Dua while in a state of rukoo #8
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ، اَللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَالْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ اَللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْوَسَخِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْاَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ، اَللّٰهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِيْ بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَالْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ اَللّٰهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِيْ مِنَ الذُّنُوْبِ وَالْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْاَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْوَسَخِ
clean: اللهم ربنا لك الحمد ملء السموات وملء الارض وملء ما شءت من شيء بعد اللهم طهرني بالثلج والبرد والماء البارد اللهم طهرني من الذنوب والخطايا كما ينقي الثوب الابيض من الوسخ
transliteration: Allaahumma, rabbanaa lakal ‘hamdu, mil-as samawaati wa mil-al ardi wa mil-aa maa shi’ta min shayin ba’du, Allaahumma tah-hirni bith-thalji wal baaradi wal ma-il baarad, Allaahumma tah-hirni minadh dhunubi wal khataaya kamaa yunakkath thawbul abyadu minal wasakh.
translation: O Allah! our Lord, unto Thee be praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and fill that which will please Thee besides (them). O Allah! purify me with snow, (water of) hail and with cold water; O Allah. cleanse me from the sins and errors just as a white garment is cleansed from dirt.

name: Dhikr before starting the prayer after waking up
content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when woke up at night, he uttered 10 times:
uthmani: اَللَّهُ اَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu Akbaar
translation: Allah is the Greatest.

name: Dua for starting Tahajjud prayer #2
content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stand in the night prayer and say this first 10 times:
uthmani: اَللَّهُ اَكْبَرُ
indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ
clean: الله اكبر
transliteration: Allahu Akbaar
translation: Allah is the greatest!
note: Asim ibn Humayd said: I asked Aisha (RA): By what words the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would begin his tahajjud prayer at night? She replied: You ask me about a thing of which no one asked me before you. (Then she mentioned the above dua)

name: Dua of the dweller for the traveler
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اطْوِ لَهُ الْأَرْضَ وَهَوِّنْ عَلَيْهِ السَّفَرَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اطْوِ لَهُ الْاَرْضَ وَهَوِّنْ عَلَيْهِ السَّفَرَ
clean: اللهم اطو له الارض وهون عليه السفر
transliteration: Allahummatwi lahul-arda wa hawwin `alaihis-safar.
translation: O Allah make near for him the distance, and ease for him the journey.

name: Dua after throwing stones at Jamara
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ حَجًّا مَّبْرُورًا، وَّذَنْۢبًا مَّغْفُوْرًا.
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ حَجًّا مَّبْرُوْرًا، وَّذَنْۢبًا مَّغْفُوْرًا.
clean: اللهم اجعله حجا مبرورا وذنبا مغفورا
transliteration: Allaahummaj alhu habbam mabru’ran wa dhambam maghfura.
translation: O Allah, make this Hajj - Hajj Mabrur (full of goodness and free from sins) and forgive all sins.

name: Dua to be recited in Hajj
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ حَجَّةً لَا رِيَاءَ فِيْهَا وَلَا سُمْعَةَ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ حَجَّةً لَّا رِيَاءَ فِيْهَا وَلَا سُمْعَةَ
clean: اللهم حجه لا رياء فيها ولا سمعه
transliteration: Allaahumma hajjatan laa riyaa’a fihaa wa laa sum’ah.
translation: O Allah, make this Hajj a Hajj in which there is no showing off nor reputation sought.

name: Farewell Dua during the Hajj Safar
uthmani: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِيْنَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيْمَ عَمَلِكَ
indopak: اَسْتَوْدِعُ اللّٰهَ دِيْنَكَ وَاَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيْمَ عَمَلِكَ
clean: استودع الله دينك وامانتك وخواتيم عملك
transliteration: Astawdi'ullaaha deenaka, wa amaanataka, wa khawaateema 'amalik
translation: I leave your religion in the care of Allah, as well as your safety, and the result of your deeds.

name: Farewell Dua for Hajji
uthmani: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى وَغَفَرَ ذَۢنْبَكَ وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ
indopak: زَوَّدَكَ اللّٰهُ التَّقْوَى وَغَفَرَ ذَنْۢبَكَ وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ
clean: زودك الله التقوي وغفر ذنبك ويسر لك الخير حيثما كنت
transliteration: Zawwadakal-laahut-taqwaa, wa ghafara dhambaka, wa yassara lakal-khayra haythu maa kunta
translation: May Allah give you piety as your provision, forgive your sins, and make goodness easy for you wherever you are.

name: Dua to be recited between the green light in Hajj
uthmani: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الأَعَزُّ الأَكْرَمُ
indopak: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ، اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْاَعَزُّ الْاَكْرَمُ
clean: رب اغفر وارحم انك انت الاعز الاكرم
transliteration: Rabbighfir warham, innaka antal a’adh-dhul akram.
translation: O Allah! Forgive me, You are the Mighty, the Merciful
reference: Mawquf Sahih (Ibn Hazar). Al Futuhatur Rabbaniyyah: 4/401

name: Dua to be recited when starting Saai
uthmani: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ، أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ
indopak: اِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللّٰهِ، اَبْدَاُ بِمَا بَدَاَ اللّٰهُ بِهِ
clean: ان الصفا والمروه من شعاءر الله ابدا بما بدا الله به
transliteration: Inna assafa wal-marwata min shaAAa-iri Allah. Abdawu bimaa bada-allahu bihi.
translation: Surely Safa-Marwa is a sign of Allah. I am starting with what Allah has started

name: Dua to be recited during facing the Kaaba
content: Climb the Safa mountain and stand facing the Baitullah and proclaim the oneness, greatness and praise of Allah -
uthmani: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ‏ وَحْدَهُ ‏لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ‏، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيْتُ وَهَوُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اَللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَةُ.
indopak: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ‏ وَحْدَهُ ‏لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ‏، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِيْ وَيُمِيْتُ وَهَوُ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ‏ وَحْدَهُ ‏لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، اَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْاَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ.
clean: لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد يحيي ويميت وهو علي كل شيء قدير لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له انجز وعده ونصر عبده وهزم الاحزاب وحده
transliteration: laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa sharika lahu, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu yuh-i wa yumitu wa huwa ‘alaa kulli shayin qadir, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa sharika lahu, anjaza wa’dahu wa nasara ‘abdahu, wa hazamal ahzaaba wa-’adah.
translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the kingdom. Praise be to Him. He gives lives and he gives death. He has power over all things. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. He has fulfilled His promise, has helped His servant, and He alone has defeated His enemies.

name: Dua to be recited during the intention of Hajj
uthmani: لَبَّيْكَ اَللَّهمَّ بِحَجَّةٍ (لَبَّيْكَ حَجًّا)
indopak: لَبَّيْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ بِحَجَّةٍ (لَبَّيْكَ حَجًّا)
clean: لبيك اللهم بحجه لبيك حجا
transliteration: Labbaika allaahumma bihajjah (labbaika hajja)
translation: O Allah! I am present for the purpose of Hajj.

name: Dua to be recited during the intention of Umrah
uthmani: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهمَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ
indopak: لَبَّيْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ
clean: لبيك اللهم بعمره
transliteration: Labbaika allaahumma bi-'Umrah
translation: O Allah! I am present for the purpose of 'Umrah.

name: Dua to be recited when visiting the Kaaba
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْك السَّلَامُ فَحَيِّنَا رَبَّنَا بِالسَّلَامِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ فَحَيِّنَا رَبَّنَا بِالسَّلَامِ
clean: اللهم انت السلام ومنك السلام فحينا ربنا بالسلام
transliteration: Allaahumma antas salaam, wa minkas salaam, fa-hayyinaa rabbanaa bissalaam.
translation: O, Allah! You are the peace (holy). Peace from you. Therefore, O our Lord! Keep us alive in peace.

name: Dua to be recited between two rukans during Tawaf
uthmani: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
indopak: رَبَّنَا اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
clean: ربنا اتنا في الدنيا حسنه وفي الاخره حسنه وقنا عذاب النار
transliteration: Rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanataw, wa fil-aakhirati hasanataw, wa qinaa ‘adhaaban-Naar.
translation: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

name: Dua to be recited before sacrificing animal
uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا مِنْكَ وَلَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ هٰذَا مِنْكَ وَلَكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّيْ
clean: بسم الله والله اكبر اللهم ان هذا منك ولك اللهم تقبل مني
transliteration: Bismillaahi wallaahu akbar, allaahumma inna haadha minka walak, allaahumma taqabbal minni.
translation: I am sacrificing with the name of Allah. And Allah is the Greatest. O Allah! It's from you and for you. O Allah! Please accept it from me.
note:
If it is on behalf of the family, then Wamin Ahli Baiti will be added after ‘Takbabbal Minni’. If the sacrifice is from someone else or if it is an Akika animal, take the name of that person or child after ‘Takabbal Min’.

It is clear that no additional Dua on this subject is authentic.

name: Dua for halal riziq (provision) gain
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ خَطَايَايَ وَذُنُوبِيْ كُلَّهَا، اَللَّهُمَّ انْعِشْنِيْ وَأَحْيِنِيْ وَارْزُقْنِيْ وَاهْدِنِيْ لِصَالِحِ الْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَخْلَاقِ، إِنَّهٗ لَا يَهْدِيْ لِصَالِحِهَا وَلَا يَصْرِفُ سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ خَطَايَايَ وَذُنُوْبِيْ كُلَّهَا، اَللّٰهُمَّ انْعِشْنِيْ وَاَحْيِنِيْ وَارْزُقْنِيْ وَاهْدِنِيْ لِصَالِحِ الْاَعْمَالِ وَالْاَخْلَاقِ، اِنَّهُ لَا يَهْدِيْ لِصَالِحِهَا وَلَا يَصْرِفُ سَيِّئَهَا اِلَّا اَنْتَ.
clean: اللهم اغفر لي خطاياي وذنوبي كلها اللهم انعشني واحيني وارزقني واهدني لصالح الاعمال والاخلاق انه لا يهدي لصالحها ولا يصرف سيءها الا انت
transliteration: Allahummaghfir lee khataayaaya wa dhunubi kullahaa, Allahumman ‘ishni wa a’hyini warzuqni wahdini lisaalihil a’maali wal akhlaaqi innahu laa yahdi li’saalihihaa wa laa yathrifu sayyiyaha illaa anta.
translation: O Allah, forgive me all my sins. O Allah, grant me high rank. Give me a good life and halal food. Guide me also into the good behaviors and to avoid displaying some profane ones. Surely no one can guide me to good deeds and good morals except you. No one can save me from evil deeds and inferior character except you.

name: Dua to be recited in danger
uthmani: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ، اَللَّهُمَّ عِنْدَكَ أَحْتَسِبُ مُصِيْبَتِيْ فَأْجُرْنِيْ فِيْهَا وَأَبْدِلْنِيْ مِنْهَا خَيْرًا.
indopak: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَاِنَّا اِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ عِنْدَكَ اَحْتَسِبُ مُصِيْبَتِيْ فَاْجُرْنِيْ فِيْهَا وَاَبْدِلْنِيْ مِنْهَا خَيْرًا.
clean: انا لله وانا اليه راجعون اللهم عندك احتسب مصيبتي فاجرني فيها وابدلني منها خيرا
transliteration: Inna lillaahi wa inna ilayhi raaji`un, Allaahumma `indaka ahtasibu musibati fa’jurni fihaa wa abdilni minhaa khair.
translation: Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return. O Allah, I seek reward with You for my affliction, so reward me for it, and replace it for me with something better.

name: Dua for the return of lost objects
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ رَادَّ الضَّالَّةِ وَهَادِيَ الضَّلَالَةِ أَنْتَ تَهْدِيْ مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، اُرْدُدْ عَلَيَّ ضَالَّتِيْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ عَطَائِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ.
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَادَّ الضَّالَّةِ وَهَادِيَ الضَّلَالَةِ اَنْتَ تَهْدِيْ مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، اُرْدُدْ عَلَيَّ ضَالَّتِيْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ فَاِنَّهَا مِنْ عَطَائِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ.
clean: اللهم راد الضاله وهادي الضلاله انت تهدي من الضلاله اردد علي ضالتي بقدرتك وسلطانك فانها من عطاءك وفضلك
transliteration: Allaahumma raaddad daallati wa haadiyad dalaalati anta tahdi minad dalaalah, urdud alayya daallati biqudratika wa sultaanika fainnahaa min ataaika wa fadlik.
translation: O Allah, the Returner of lost things, the Guide to the lost, You are the Guide to the lost. You, in your power and strength, give me back what I lost. Because, this object is given by you and I got it by your grace.

name: Dua to be recited in times of anxiety
uthmani: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
indopak: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ الْحَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
clean: لا اله الا الله الحليم الكريم سبحان الله رب السموات السبع ورب العرش العظيم الحمد لله رب العالمين
transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahul halimul karim, subhaanallaahi rabbis samawaatis sab’i wa rabbil ‘arshil ‘azim, alhamdu lillaahi rabbil ‘aalamin.
translation: There is no true God but Allah the Most Patient, the Most Honorable. I am proclaiming the holiness of the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the glorious throne. All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

name: Dua for those who want to go to war
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أُقَاتِلُ وَبِكَ أُصَاوِلُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِكَ اُقَاتِلُ وَبِكَ اُصَاوِلُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ
clean: اللهم بك اقاتل وبك اصاول ولا حول ولا قوه الا بالله
transliteration: Allaahumma bika uqaatilu wabika usaawilu wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah.
translation: O Allah, I fight with Your help, I attack with Your help.  No power or ability is (effective) without your help.

name: Dua for the warriors
uthmani: اُغْزُوا بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي سَبِيْلِ اللَّهِ قَاتِلُوا مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ اُغْزُوا وَلَا تَغُلُّوا وَلَا تَغْدِرُوا وَلَا تَمْثُلُوا وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا وَلِيْدًا
indopak: اُغْزُوْا بِاسْمِ اللّٰهِ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ قَاتِلُوْا مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللّٰهِ اُغْزُوْا وَلَا تَغُلُّوْا وَلَا تَغْدِرُوْا وَلَا تَمْثُلُوْا وَلَا تَقْتُلُوْا وَلِيْدًا
clean: اغزوا باسم الله في سبيل الله قاتلوا من كفر بالله اغزوا ولا تغلوا ولا تغدروا ولا تمثلوا ولا تقتلوا وليدا
transliteration: Ughzu bismillaahi fi sabilillaahi qaatilu man kafara billaahi. Ughzu wa laa tagullu wa laa tagdiru wa laa tamthulu wa laa taqtulu walida.
translation: Fight in the name of Allaah and in the path of Allaah and with him who disbelieves in Allaah fight and do not be treacherous and do not be dishonest about boot yand do not deface (in killing) and do not kill a child.
note: If someone is made the amir (commander) of a small or large army (or on behalf of a contemporary ruler) he will bequeath to him the fear of Allah about himself and to treat the Muslims (Soldiers) under him well. Then say - (the Dua is mentioned above)

name: If you see someone smiling
uthmani: أَضْحَكَ اللَّهُ سِنَّكَ
indopak: اَضْحَكَ اللّٰهُ سِنَّكَ
clean: اضحك الله سنك
transliteration: Adh’haka allahu sinnak
translation: May Allah keep you happy always.

name: Dua for whom repaying the debts
uthmani: أَوْفَيْتَنِيْ أَوْفَى اللَّهُ بِكَ
indopak: اَوْفَيْتَنِيْ اَوْفَى اللّٰهُ بِكَ
clean: اوفيتني اوفي الله بك
transliteration: Aw’faitani awfallahu bik
translation: You have repaid my debt in full, may Allah reward you in full.

name: Sermon to those who want to go to war # 1
uthmani: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ لَا تَتَمَنَّوْا لِقَاءَ الْعَدُوِّ وَسَلُوْا اللَّهَ الْعَافِيَةَ، فَإِذَا لَقِيْتُمُوْهُمْ فَاصْبِرُوْا، وَاعْلَمُوْا أَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ تَحْتَ ظِلَالِ السُّيُوفِ.
indopak: يَا اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ لَا تَتَمَنَّوْا لِقَاءَ الْعَدُوِّ وَسَلُوْا اللّٰهَ الْعَافِيَةَ، فَاِذَا لَقِيْتُمُوْهُمْ فَاصْبِرُوْا، وَاعْلَمُوْا اَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ تَحْتَ ظِلَالِ السُّيُوْفِ.
clean: يا ايها الناس لا تتمنوا لقاء العدو وسلوا الله العافيه فاذا لقيتموهم فاصبروا واعلموا ان الجنه تحت ظلال السيوف
transliteration: Yaa ayyuhan naas, laa tatamannaw liqaa’al ‘aduyyi wa salullaahal ‘aafiyah, faa idhaa laqitumuhum faasbiru waa’lamu annal jannata tahta zilaalis suyyuf.
translation: O people! Do not wish to face the enemy (in a battle) and ask Allah to save you (from calamities) but if you should face the enemy, then be patient and let it be known to you that Paradise is under the shades of swords.

name: Sermon to those who want to go to war # 2
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، وَمُجْرِيَ السَّحَابِ، وَهَازِمَ الْأَحْزَابِ، اِهْزِمْهُمْ وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ.
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، وَمُجْرِيَ السَّحَابِ، وَهَازِمَ الْاَحْزَابِ، اِهْزِمْهُمْ وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ.
clean: اللهم منزل الكتاب ومجري السحاب وهازم الاحزاب اهزمهم وانصرنا عليهم
transliteration: Allaahumma munzilal kitaab, wa muj’riyas sahaab wa haazimal ahzaab, ihzimhum wansurnaa alayhim.
translation: O Allah! The Revealer of the (Holy) Book, the Mover of the clouds, and Defeater of Al-Ahzab (i.e. the clans of infidels), defeat them infidels and bestow victory upon us.

name: Sermon to those who want to go to war # 3
uthmani: إِنَّا إِذَا نَزَلْنَا بِسَاحَةِ قَوْمٍ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِيْنَ
indopak: اِنَّا اِذَا نَزَلْنَا بِسَاحَةِ قَوْمٍ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِيْنَ
clean: انا اذا نزلنا بساحه قوم فساء صباح المنذرين
transliteration: Inna idhaa nazalnaa bisaahati qawm, fasaa’a sabaahul mundharin.
translation: Surely when we approach a (hostile) nation (to fight), then evil will be the morning for those who have been warned."

name: Dua for seeking useful knowledge
uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِيْ بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِيْ وَعَلِّمْنِيْ مَا يَنْفَعُنِيْ وَارْزُقْنِيْ عِلْمًا تَنْفَعُنِيْ بِهِ.
indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ انْفَعْنِيْ بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِيْ وَعَلِّمْنِيْ مَا يَنْفَعُنِيْ وَارْزُقْنِيْ عِلْمًا تَنْفَعُنِيْ بِهِ.
clean: اللهم انفعني بما علمتني وعلمني ما ينفعني وارزقني علما تنفعني به
transliteration: Allaahumman fa’ni bimaa allamtani wa allimni ma yanfayuni war’zuqni ilman tanfayuni bihi.
translation: O Allah, benefit me with the knowledge You have bestowed on me. Give me the knowledge that will benefit me and give me the knowledge by which you will benefit me.
